# Profound AI 搜索术语词典｜完整中文译文与英文原文

- 原标题：The AI Search Glossary: A definition of 300+ terms
- 作者：[Justin Champion](https://www.linkedin.com/in/championjr/)，Profound University 内容负责人
- 发布日期：2026-08-20
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29
- 来源：https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/ai-search-glossary
- 本版包含：15 个分类、356 个术语、完整 A–Z 索引与结尾说明；各段保留英文原文及原有链接。
- 译注：平台状态、统计数据、术语口径及观点均按作者原文译出，未作为本次独立核实的结论。

![原文封面](<../../90_附件/配图/Profound_AI搜索术语词典_封面.png>)

## 前言

人们查找信息的方式已经改变，而描述它的语言仍在不断创造中。这是一份综合性资料，帮助你掌握 AI 搜索、答案引擎优化和智能体网络的正确术语。

**英文原文**

The way people find information has changed, and the language for it is still being invented. This is a comprehensive resource to stay up to speed on proper AI Search, Answer Engine Optimization, and the agentic web terminology.

下面每个词条都包含通俗易懂的定义，以及简短说明，解释它为什么与你的品牌有关。

**英文原文**

Every term below consists of a plain-English definition, and a short descriptor explaining why it matters to your brand.

值得收藏。这套词汇更新很快：产品会更名，爬虫会一分为三，拟议标准可能写到一半就被放弃。我们会持续更新本页，因此反复回来查阅，比复制一份更有用。

**英文原文**

**Worth bookmarking.** This vocabulary has a short half-life. Products get renamed, crawlers get split into three, proposed standards get abandoned mid-draft. We keep this page current, which makes it more useful to come back to than to copy.

如何阅读本词典：术语分为 15 节，便于按顺序学习；底部另有 A–Z 索引，方便查找。如果刚接触这个领域，从核心概念开始；如果要建立衡量项目，从衡量方法与指标开始。

**英文原文**

**How to read this glossary.** Terms are grouped into 15 sections so you can learn the subject in order, and indexed A–Z at the bottom so you can easily find what you're looking for. If you're new to this, start with Core Concepts. If you're building a measurement program, start with Measurement and Metrics.

## 1. 核心概念／Core concepts

### 001. AI 搜索（AI Search）

使用人工智能理解提问者的意思，并直接写出答案的一类搜索，通常会附上影响答案的来源链接。系统代你决定哪些品牌被提及，这正是本词典存在的原因。我们的 AEO 指南从基本原理出发介绍整个领域。

**英文原文**

A type of search that uses artificial intelligence to understand what someone is asking and write them a direct answer, usually with links back to sources that influenced the answer. The system decides on your behalf which brands get named, which is the entire reason this glossary exists. Our [AEO Guide](<https://www.tryprofound.com/aeo-guide>) walks through the whole discipline from first principles.

### 002. 答案引擎（Answer Engine）

任何用连贯文字回答问题，而不是返回一页排名结果的 AI 系统。ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot、Claude 和 Google 的 AI 界面都是答案引擎，各自根据自己的来源得出结论。

**英文原文**

Any AI system that responds to a question with prose rather than a page of ranked results. ChatGPT, [Gemini](<https://www.tryprofound.com/articles/rank-in-google-gemini>), Perplexity, Copilot, Claude and Google's AI surfaces are all Answer Engines, and each one reaches its own conclusions from its own sources.

### 003. 生成式引擎（Generative Engine）

与答案引擎近乎同义。学术研究更偏爱这个说法，因为它强调答案是生成的，而不是检索出来的。该术语来自提出 GEO 概念的 2023 年研究论文。

**英文原文**

A near-synonym for Answer Engine, preferred in academic work because it emphasizes that the answer is generated rather than retrieved. The term comes from the [2023 research paper](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09735>) that coined GEO.

### 004. 答案引擎优化（AEO）（Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)）

为提高内容在 AI 生成回答中的可见度和被引用机会而开展的优化实践。传统 SEO 旨在让页面获得关键词排名并带来点击，AEO 则优先争取让答案引擎选择并提及你，把你作为用户问题的权威答案。参见我们关于答案引擎优化的完整说明。

**英文原文**

The practice of optimizing content for visibility and citations in AI-generated responses. Where traditional SEO aims to rank pages for keywords and drive clicks, AEO prioritizes being selected and mentioned by answer engines as the authoritative answer to a user’s question. See our full explainer on [what Answer Engine Optimization is](<https://www.tryprofound.com/articles/what-is-answer-engine-optimization>).

### 005. 生成式引擎优化（GEO）（Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)）

与 AEO 属于同一领域，只是名称不同。该术语由 2023 年的一篇学术论文提出，经 Andreessen Horowitz 推广而流行。如今多数从业者交替使用 AEO 和 GEO；我们也写过文章，解释为什么二者的区别通常不重要。

**英文原文**

The same discipline as AEO under a different name. The term was coined in a [2023 academic paper](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09735>), and was made popular by [Andreessen Horowitz](<https://a16z.com/geo-over-seo/>). Most practitioners now use AEO and GEO interchangeably, and [we have written on why the distinction rarely matters](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/aeo-vs-geo>).

### 006. 大语言模型优化（LLMO）（LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization)）

AEO 的另一个同义词，受到那些希望强调技术而非界面的人的偏爱。它在命名竞争中已经落后，但仍出现在职位名称里。

**英文原文**

Another synonym for AEO, favored by people who want to name the technology rather than the interface. It has lost the naming race but still appears in job titles.

### 007. AI SEO（AI SEO）

一个总括性术语，既包括针对 AI 搜索进行优化，也包括使用 AI 工具开展 SEO。问题就在于这种歧义，所以如果你指的是前者，最好用 AEO。

**英文原文**

An umbrella term covering both optimizing for AI Search and using AI tools to do SEO work. The ambiguity is the problem, so prefer AEO when you mean the former.

### 008. 术语之争（Terminology war）

行业尚未解决的命名争论：到底叫 AEO、GEO、LLMO、GAIO、AIO，还是 AI 搜索优化？2025 年一项针对 200 多名 SEO 专家的调查发现，36% 的人偏好“AI 搜索优化”，为最高占比，但没有任何选项超过半数，因此并不存在可遵循的共识。

**英文原文**

The unresolved industry argument over whether to call this AEO, GEO, LLMO, GAIO, AIO or AI Search optimization. A [2025 survey](<https://searchengineland.com/ai-search-optimization-survey-2025-461939>) of more than 200 SEO specialists found a 36% plurality preferred "AI Search optimization," with no option taking a majority, so there's no consensus to defer to.

### 009. 相关性工程（Relevance engineering）

重新理解 AEO 的一种方式：强调通过工程方法让机器理解内容，而不是追逐算法。它是一种有用的思维方式，也表明使用这个说法的人读过不止入门文章。

**英文原文**

A reframing of AEO that emphasizes engineering how a machine understands your content rather than chasing an algorithm. Useful as a mindset, and a signal that the person using it has read past the introductory posts.

### 010. AI 可见度（AI visibility）

你的品牌是否出现在针对买家真实问题的 AI 答案中。可见度关注“是否出现”，它是任何 AEO 项目的起点，而非终点。Profound 通过 Answer Engine Insights 追踪这一指标。

**英文原文**

Whether your brand appears in AI answers to the questions your buyers actually ask. Visibility is the presence question, and it's the floor of any AEO program rather than the ceiling. Profound tracks it through [Answer Engine Insights](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights>).

### 011. 零点击搜索（Zero-click search）

在搜索结果页内就结束的查询。Profound 与 Kevin Indig、Clickstream Solutions 合作开展的行为研究发现，92.8% 的 AI 购物任务结束时，没有对开放网络产生有实质意义的点击。

**英文原文**

A search query that ends right on the search results page. Profound's [behavioral study with Kevin Indig and Clickstream Solutions](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/the-shortlist-is-the-new-shelf>) found 92.8% of AI shopping tasks ended with no meaningful click to the open web.

### 012. 答案层（Answer layer）

如今位于你的内容与买家之间的 AI 生成回答。你的内容仍在发挥作用，但答案层决定你能从中获得多少认可。

**英文原文**

The AI-generated response that now sits between your content and your buyer. Your content still does the work, but the answer layer decides how much credit you get for it.

### 013. 站内／页面内（On-site / On-page）

你能控制并且今天就能修改的第一方内容，包括产品页、比较页、文档、博客和常见问题。

**英文原文**

The first-party content you control and can edit today. Your product pages, comparison pages, docs, blog and FAQs.

### 014. 站外／页面外（Off-site / Off-page）

在你无法控制的平台上，别人对你说的一切。评价网站、Reddit、行业媒体、清单文章和竞争对手比较页，共同对 AI 可见度产生的影响远超多数团队的预期。Profound 的引用来源分析按类别和平台拆解了这一构成。

**英文原文**

Everything said about you on properties you don't control. Review sites, Reddit, trade press, listicles and competitor comparison pages, which collectively drive far more of your AI visibility than most teams expect. Profound's [citation-source analysis](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/where-do-ai-citations-come-from>) breaks the mix down by category and platform.

### 015. 第三方验证（Third-party validation）

模型已经信任的来源对你的主张作出的独立确认。AI 答案依靠外部佐证，因此，如果只有你自己的网站说你最好，这几乎毫无价值。

**英文原文**

Independent confirmation of your claims from sources the model already trusts. AI answers lean on outside corroboration, so being the only site that says you're the best is worth close to nothing.

### 016. 第三方信号（Third-party signals）

评价网站、行业媒体、论坛、分析师等独立来源对你的描述。AI 答案高度依赖外部确认，所以你在自有网站之外的存在，对答案的塑造作用不亚于站内内容。

**英文原文**

What independent sources such as review sites, trade press, forums and analysts say about you. AI answers lean heavily on outside confirmation, so your presence beyond your own site shapes the answer as much as your presence on it.

### 017. 品牌搜索结果页（Brand SERP）

用户直接搜索品牌名称时出现的内容。这仍是快速判断机器是否理解“你是谁”的最佳方式。

**英文原文**

What appears when someone searches your brand name directly. It remains the fastest read on whether machines understand who you are.

### 018. 智能体搜索（Agentic search）

软件代表人进行的搜索，包括研究选项、进行比较，有时还完成购买。当阅读者是程序，页面设计的重点就从说服转向了可解析性。

**英文原文**

Search performed by software on a person's behalf, researching options, comparing them and sometimes completing the purchase. When the reader is a program, page design stops being a persuasion problem and becomes a parsing problem.

### 019. 对话式搜索（Conversational search）

以对话方式展开的搜索，追问取代重新发起查询。这意味着你的品牌需要在一连串答案中站稳脚跟，而不只是出现一次。

**英文原文**

Search conducted as a dialogue, where follow-up questions replace new queries. It means your brand has to survive not one answer but a sequence of them.

### 020. AI 助手（AI assistant）

围绕模型封装的面向消费者的产品，例如 ChatGPT 应用或 Gemini 应用。大多数 AI 搜索实际上发生在助手中，所以衡量模型并不等于衡量用户使用的界面。

**英文原文**

The consumer-facing product wrapped around a model, such as the ChatGPT app or the Gemini app. Assistants are where most AI Search actually happens, which is why measuring the model isn't the same as measuring the surface.

### 021. 提示词（Prompt）

人们输入或口述给 AI 系统的问题。在 AEO 中，提示词取代关键词成为衡量单位；它更长，意图也更具体。Profound 对超过 5,000 万个 ChatGPT 提示词的意图研究，拆解了人们实际在问什么。

**英文原文**

The question a person types or speaks to an AI system. In AEO the prompt replaces the keyword as the unit of measurement. It's longer and far more specific in intent. Profound's [study of ChatGPT intent](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/chatgpt-intent-landmark-study>) across more than 50 million prompts breaks down what people actually ask for.

### 022. 品牌关联（Association）

AI 搜索当前如何描述你的品牌：它从整个网络汇总出的描述、类别和主张。品牌关联是 AEO 的起点，因为只有知道 AI 目前把你放在哪里，才能缩短与目标位置的距离。

**英文原文**

What AI Search says about your brand today: the descriptions, categories and claims it has assembled from across the web. Associations are where AEO starts, because you can't close the distance to where you want to be until you know where AI has you now.

### 023. 属性（Attribute）

你希望 AI 搜索如何描述品牌，即希望被认可的具体主张、优势和特征。属性是 AEO 项目追求的目标状态，每项都必须具体到能够追踪。在 Profound 的 Sentiment 视图中，属性的含义更窄：答案引擎已经作出的、带有正面或负面倾向的主张。

**英文原文**

What you want AI Search to say about your brand: the specific claims, strengths and characteristics you'd like to be known for. Attributes are the target state an AEO program works toward, and each one has to be specific enough to track. In Profound's Sentiment view, attribute means something narrower: a claim an Answer Engine already makes, with positive or negative polarity.

### 024. 属性清单（Attribute list）

你希望 AI 搜索对品牌说出的具体内容所组成的简短清单，每项都应具体到可以测试。AEO 项目的每项结果都要对照这份清单解读。

**英文原文**

A short list of the specific things you want AI Search to say about your brand, each one specific enough to test. Every result in an AEO program gets read against it.

### 025. 权威性（AEO 语境）（Authority (AEO sense)）

拥有足够的可信度和存在感，以至于能够进入 AI 答案。权威性首先是“能否出现”的问题，也是品牌进入新品类时最基础的问题。它不同于主题权威性或域名权威性。

**英文原文**

Being credible and present enough to show up in AI answers at all. Authority is a presence problem, and it's the foundational one for a brand entering a new category. Not the same as Topical authority or Domain authority.

### 026. 长尾相关性（Long-tail relevance）

被足够具体地理解，从而赢得那些决定购买的提示词。长尾相关性关乎具体程度；一个确有权威性的品牌，仍可能输给内容更贴合具体问题的对手。

**英文原文**

Being understood specifically enough to win the prompts that decide purchases. Long-tail relevance is a specificity problem, and it's where a brand with real authority can still lose to a competitor whose content matches the exact question.

### 027. AIO（AIO）

AI 搜索优化的缩写，是 AEO 这一领域的另一名称。首次使用时应写出全称。

**英文原文**

An abbreviation for AI Search optimization, another name for the same discipline as AEO. Spell it out on first use.

### 028. SAGE（SAGE）

Profound 用于系统改善 AEO 的四阶段循环：Setup（设置）、Analyze（分析）、Generate（生成）、Engineer（工程化）。每阶段结束都有一项产出：可信基线、可靠差距清单、真正落地的工作，以及能够持续积累效果的系统。

**英文原文**

Profound's four-stage loop for systematic AEO improvement: Setup, Analyze, Generate, Engineer. Each stage ends in an output: a baseline you trust, a gap list you believe, work that actually shipped, and a system that compounds.


## 2. AI 与大语言模型基础／AI and LLM fundamentals

### 029. 人工智能（AI）（Artificial intelligence (AI)）

执行通常与人类思考相关任务的软件，例如理解语言、识别模式。它是本词典中其他术语所属的总括概念。

**英文原文**

Software that performs tasks we associate with human thinking, such as understanding language and recognizing patterns. It's the umbrella over every other term in this glossary.

### 030. 机器学习（Machine learning）

现代 AI 背后的方法：系统从数据中学习模式，而不是遵循人工编写的规则。这就是为什么 OpenAI 没有人能精确告诉你，模型为何提到了你的竞争对手。

**英文原文**

The approach behind modern AI, where systems learn patterns from data instead of following hand-written rules. It's why nobody at OpenAI can tell you exactly why the model named your competitor.

### 031. 生成式 AI（Generative AI）

能够产生新内容，而不只是对已有内容分类的 AI。答案引擎就是应用于搜索的生成式 AI。

**英文原文**

AI that produces new content rather than just classifying existing content. Answer Engines are generative AI pointed at search.

### 032. 大语言模型（LLM）（Large language model (LLM)）

在海量文本上训练、能够预测语言的模型，并因此写出买家看到的答案。每个答案引擎都建立在某个大语言模型之上。

**英文原文**

A model trained on enormous volumes of text that predicts language, and in doing so writes the answers your buyers read. Every Answer Engine sits on top of one.

### 033. 基础模型（Foundation model）

投入高昂成本进行一次训练，然后适配多种用途的大型通用模型。GPT、Gemini、Claude 和 Llama 都属于基础模型。

**英文原文**

A large, general-purpose model trained once at great expense and then adapted to many uses. GPT, Gemini, Claude and Llama are foundation models.

### 034. 前沿模型（Frontier model）

在某个时刻最新、能力最强的模型。这一标签不断变化，实际结果就是你的 AEO 基线每隔几个月便会被重置。

**英文原文**

The newest and most capable models available at any moment. The label moves constantly, and the practical consequence is that your AEO baseline resets every few months.

### 035. Transformer 架构（Transformer）

现代语言模型背后的神经网络架构，也是 GPT 中 T 的含义。它让模型同时衡量一段文字中所有词语之间的关系，因此擅长理解意义，而不只是做匹配。

**英文原文**

The [neural network architecture](<https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762>) behind modern language models, and the T in GPT. It lets a model weigh the relationships between all the words in a passage at once, which is what makes it good at meaning rather than matching.

### 036. 注意力（Attention）

Transformer 内部用于判断输入的哪些部分对下一个词最重要的机制。注意力分布不均，因此一个事实放在页面的什么位置，会影响模型是否使用它。

**英文原文**

The mechanism inside a transformer that decides which parts of the input matter most for the next word. Attention is unevenly distributed, which is why where a fact sits inside your page affects whether the model uses it.

### 037. 词元（Token）（Token）

模型读取和写入的文本单位，大致相当于四分之三个单词。价格、速度、上下文限制，以及大多数 AEO 展示指标，都是按词元计量的。

**英文原文**

The unit of text a model reads and writes, roughly three quarters of a word. Pricing, speed, context limits and most AEO impression metrics are all counted in tokens.

### 038. 上下文窗口（Context window）

模型一次能够容纳的文本量。尽早陈述关键事实的内容，在拥挤的上下文窗口里更容易保留下来；把事实埋在后面的内容则不然。

**英文原文**

The amount of text a model can hold in mind at once. Content that states its key facts early survives a crowded context window, and content that buries them doesn't.

### 039. 参数化记忆（Parametric memory）

模型通过训练获得并存储在自身记忆中，而不是临时查找的知识。无法访问网络时，这些知识仍存在；也因此，即使造成旧印象的页面已不存在，关于公司的过时事实仍可能留存。

**英文原文**

What the model knows from training, stored in its memory rather than looked up. This is the knowledge that persists when the model can't reach the web, and it's the reason stale facts about your company outlive the pages that caused them.

### 040. 非参数化记忆（Non-parametric memory）

模型回答时从外部来源获取的知识。检索属于非参数化记忆，也是系统中你本周就能影响、而不用等到明年的部分。

**英文原文**

Knowledge the model pulls in at answer time from an external source. Retrieval is non-parametric memory, and it's the part of the system you can influence this week rather than next year.

### 041. 训练数据（Training data）

模型发布前学过的一切。在公司训练新模型之前，它保持不变。因此，在那个日期之后你修改的内容，只有被检索到，才会进入模型视野。

**英文原文**

Everything the model learned before release. It's fixed until the company trains a new model, so anything you changed after that date exists for the model only if retrieval finds it.

### 042. 训练数据截止日期（Training data cutoff）

模型内置知识停止更新的日期。此后发布的新品、品牌重塑和价格变化，如果没有实时来源承载，模型就看不到。

**英文原文**

The date after which a model's built-in knowledge stops. Your launches, rebrands and price changes since that date are invisible unless a live source carries them.

### 043. 实际知识截止点（Effective cutoff）

模型知识真正开始稀薄的位置，通常早于标称截止日期，因为近期事件在训练数据中代表不足。应假定模型对你所在品类的实际认识，比文档声称的更陈旧。

**英文原文**

The point where a model's knowledge actually gets thin, which is usually earlier than the stated cutoff because recent events are underrepresented in training data. Assume the model's real picture of your category is older than the documentation claims.

### 044. 微调（Fine-tuning）

通过额外训练，让通用模型适应特定任务或领域。它无需重建模型即可改善行为，但品牌无法借此改变公共模型对自身的看法。

**英文原文**

Extra training that adapts a general model to a specific task or domain. It sharpens behavior without rebuilding the model, and it's not something brands can do to change how a public model sees them.

### 045. 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）（RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback)）

依据人类偏好评分训练模型，让答案显得更有帮助。RLHF 使模型听起来自信、讨人喜欢，即使它把关于你的信息说错了也是如此。

**英文原文**

Training a model against human preference ratings so its answers feel more helpful. RLHF is why models sound confident and agreeable, including when they're wrong about you.

### 046. 知识蒸馏（Knowledge distillation）

训练小模型模仿大模型，得到行为相似但成本更低、速度更快的模型。许多快速、免费的产品档位使用蒸馏模型，而大量 AI 搜索实际就发生在那里。

**英文原文**

Training a smaller model to imitate a larger one, producing something cheaper and faster that behaves similarly. Distilled models power many of the fast, free tiers where a lot of AI Search actually happens.

### 047. 混合专家模型（MoE）（Mixture of Experts (MoE)）

把每个输入路由到部分专门子网络，而非整个模型的架构。它以更低成本获得能力，也是不同会话答案出现差异的原因之一。

**英文原文**

An architecture that routes each input to a subset of specialized sub-networks rather than the whole model. It buys capability at lower cost, and it's one reason answers vary between sessions.

### 048. 多模态 AI（Multimodal AI）

除了文本，还能处理图像、音频和视频的模型。你的图表、截图、产品照片和视频文字稿，现在是可读取的输入，而不只是装饰。

**英文原文**

Models that handle images, audio and video alongside text. Your charts, screenshots, product photos and video transcripts are now readable inputs, not decoration.

### 049. 温度（Temperature）

控制模型选择下一个词时随机性大小的设置。温度越高，输出越多样，这也是相同提示词两次得不到同一答案的部分原因。

**英文原文**

A setting that controls how much randomness the model uses when picking each next word. Higher temperature means more variety, which is part of why the same prompt doesn't return the same answer twice.

### 050. 非确定性（Non-determinism）

相同输入能够产生不同输出的性质。把温度设为零也无法解决：Thinking Machines Lab 在 2025 年 9 月的研究将原因追溯到 GPU 内核缺乏批次不变性，并发现一个模型在零温度下运行 1,000 次，仍产生了 80 种不同续写。

**英文原文**

The property that identical inputs can produce different outputs. Setting temperature to zero doesn't fix this: [research from Thinking Machines Lab](<https://thinkingmachines.ai/blog/defeating-nondeterminism-in-llm-inference/>) in September 2025 traced the cause to a lack of batch invariance in GPU kernels, and found one model produced 80 unique completions across 1,000 runs at temperature zero.

### 051. 答案变异性（Answer variability）

重复运行相同提示词时，AI 回答自然出现的差异。这是应通过重复抽样而非偶尔检查来衡量 AI 可见度的最重要原因，因为一次手动检查几乎说明不了什么。

**英文原文**

The natural spread in AI responses when you run the same prompt repeatedly. It's the single most important reason to measure AI visibility with repeated sampling instead of spot checks, because one manual check tells you almost nothing.

### 052. 合成数据（Synthetic data）

由模型生成、用于补充或替代人类文本的训练数据。它降低训练成本，也增加了模型长期学习自身输出的风险。

**英文原文**

Model-generated training data used to supplement or replace human-written text. It makes training cheaper and raises the long-term risk of models learning from their own output.

### 053. 推理（Inference）

运行已训练模型来生成答案的过程。每一次 AI 搜索回答都是推理；推理成本也是免费档位使用比基准测试中更弱的模型的原因。

**英文原文**

The act of running a trained model to produce an answer. Every AI Search response is an inference, and inference cost is why free tiers use weaker models than the ones in the benchmarks.

### 054. 通用人工智能（AGI）（AGI (Artificial General Intelligence)）

一种假想 AI，能够在几乎所有智力工作上匹敌人类。它是实验室讨论的目标，而非可购买的产品，因此与今天的答案引擎如何选择来源无关。

**英文原文**

A hypothetical AI matching human ability across essentially all intellectual work. It's a goal labs talk about rather than a product you can buy, so it has no bearing on how today's Answer Engines choose sources.


## 3. AI 答案如何生成／How AI answers get made

### 055. 检索（Retrieval）

AI 回答时读取实时网页，而不只依赖训练知识的步骤。模型只能使用实际获取到的内容。

**英文原文**

The step where the AI reads live web pages while answering instead of relying only on training. And the model can only use what it fetched.

### 056. 检索增强生成（RAG）（RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)）

AI 搜索背后的架构：系统先获取当前文档，再据此写答案。RAG 使 AEO 成为真实的实践领域，而不是只能等待下一代模型发布。

**英文原文**

The architecture behind AI Search, where the system fetches current documents and then writes its answer from them. RAG is the reason AEO is a real discipline and not just a waiting game on the next model release.

### 057. 依据锚定（Grounding）

让答案与特定检索来源相联系，而不是依赖模型的一般印象。有据可依的答案带有引用，没有依据的答案带来风险。

**英文原文**

Tying an answer to specific retrieved sources rather than to the model's general impressions. Grounded answers arrive with citations, and ungrounded answers arrive with risk.

### 058. 索引（Index）

AI 系统已经摄入、并在回答时搜索的页面库。每家公司维护自己的索引，因此 ChatGPT 和 Claude 对同一问题可能引用完全不同的来源。

**英文原文**

The store of pages an AI system has already ingested and searches through when it answers. Each company keeps its own, which is why ChatGPT and Claude can cite completely different sources for the same question.

### 059. 爬虫（Crawler）

从整个网络获取页面、建立索引或训练集的机器人。如果爬虫无法访问或渲染页面，模型就无法获知该页面的存在。

**英文原文**

The bot that fetches pages across the web to build an index or a training set. If a crawler can't reach or render your page, the model never learns the page exists.

### 060. 重新索引（Re-indexing）

再次抓取页面，用当前版本替换已存储副本。发布更正后，只有爬虫再次访问才会生效，因此修正过时页面是一个两步过程，而你只能控制其中一半。

**英文原文**

When a page gets fetched again and the stored copy is replaced with the current version. Publishing a correction does nothing until a crawler returns, which is why fixing an outdated page is a two-step process you only control half of.

### 061. 收录反映延迟（Pickup lag）

从来源上线或更新，到 AI 答案反映变化之间的延迟。因此，AEO 报告需要耐心等待几周，再判断某个策略是否失败。

**英文原文**

The delay between a source going live or being updated and AI answers reflecting the change. Pickup lag is why AEO reporting needs a few weeks of patience before you conclude a tactic failed.

### 062. 查询扇出（Query fan-out）

在回答前，将一个用户提示词扩展为多个后台搜索的做法。这是 Google 官方文档中的术语，但被人们归因于它的那些专利其实没有使用这个词组，而是使用合成查询、相关查询、隐含查询等名称。Profound 对 10,000 个提示词的分析发现，每个提示词约产生 1.4—2 个扇出查询；我们的查询扇出工具能展示提示词实际触发的搜索。

**英文原文**

The habit of expanding one user prompt into several background searches before answering. It's [Google's own documented terminology](<https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide>), though the phrase doesn't actually appear in the patents it gets attributed to, which use terms like synthetic, related and implied queries. Profound's [analysis of 10,000 prompts](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/what-ai-engines-actually-search-for>) found roughly 1.4 to 2 fan-out queries per prompt, and our [query fan-out tooling](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights/query-fan-out>) shows the searches your prompts actually trigger.

### 063. 合成查询（Synthetic query）

系统自行生成、而非用户输入的查询。你的内容会参与从未有人类执行过的搜索竞争，因此精确关键词思维在这里不再适用。

**英文原文**

A query the system generates itself rather than one the user typed. Your content competes in searches no human ever ran, which is why keyword-exact thinking breaks down here.

### 064. 隐含查询（Implied query）

系统推断用户实际想问的问题。它会把“这个到底好不好”转化为你从未见过的评价搜索。

**英文原文**

A question the system infers the user actually meant. It's how "is this any good" becomes a search for reviews you've never seen.

### 065. 自定义语料库（Custom corpus）

系统用来替代开放网络，或与开放网络并行搜索的精选文档集合。Google 已公开的专利申请“Query response using a custom corpus”提到了这一概念；它意味着并非所有检索都通过公共索引进行。

**英文原文**

A curated document collection a system searches instead of, or alongside, the open web. Named in Google's published patent application ["Query response using a custom corpus,"](<https://patents.google.com/patent/US20240362093A1/en>) and relevant because it means not all retrieval happens over the public index.

### 066. 段落检索（Passage retrieval）

获取页面的某个片段，而不是整页。检索系统提取的是段落，因此，一个页面实际上是一组独立参与竞争的章节。

**英文原文**

Fetching a specific chunk of a page rather than the whole page. Retrieval systems pull passages, so a page is really a collection of independently competing sections.

### 067. 分块（Chunking）

把文档拆成更小的片段，便于检索系统分别索引和获取。页面如何分块，决定了其中什么内容能被引用；你可以通过结构影响这一点。

**英文原文**

Splitting a document into smaller pieces so a retrieval system can index and fetch them individually. How your page gets chunked determines what can be quoted from it, and you influence that through structure.

### 068. 语义分块（Semantic chunking）

在主题发生变化的位置切分内容，让每一块都能独立成立。写出可独立理解的章节，是适用范围最广的 AEO 技巧，因为能够独立成立的章节，也能独立被引用。

**英文原文**

Splitting content where the topic changes, so each piece makes sense on its own. Writing sections that make sense on their own is the single most portable AEO tactic, because a section that can stand alone can be cited alone.

### 069. 后期分块（Late chunking）

先编码整个文档，再进行切分的嵌入技术，让每个块保留部分周边语境。它降低了那些必须结合前文才能理解的页面所受的不利影响。

**英文原文**

An embedding technique that encodes the whole document first and then splits it, so each chunk retains some surrounding context. It reduces the penalty for pages whose meaning depends on earlier sections.

### 070. 嵌入表示（Embeddings）

意义的数值表示，使系统能够判断一段内容与问题有多接近。AI 搜索通过这种方式衡量相关性，而不是靠关键词重叠。

**英文原文**

Numerical representations of meaning that let a system judge how close a piece of content sits to a question. Relevance in AI Search is measured this way, not by keyword overlap.

### 071. 向量数据库（Vector database）

按相似程度而非精确匹配搜索嵌入表示的数据库。它是“帮我找到意思大致如此的内容”背后的基础设施。

**英文原文**

A store built to search embeddings by similarity rather than by exact match. It's the infrastructure underneath "find me content that means roughly this."

### 072. 余弦相似度（Cosine similarity）

为两个嵌入表示的接近程度评分的标准数学方法。这个分数决定你的段落能否进入候选集。

**英文原文**

The standard math for scoring how close two embeddings are. It's the number that decides whether your passage makes the candidate set.

### 073. 语义搜索（Semantic search）

依据含义而非精确措辞进行检索。页面可能在一个与它没有任何相同词汇的问题下出现，却在词汇完全相同的问题下缺席。

**英文原文**

Retrieval based on meaning rather than exact wording. A page can surface for a question that shares none of its vocabulary and miss one that shares all of it.

### 074. 候选集（Candidate set）

模型写作前真正考虑的检索段落短名单。进入候选集和获得引用是两场不同的竞争，而大多数内容在第一场就输了。

**英文原文**

The shortlist of retrieved passages the model actually considers before writing. Getting into the candidate set and getting cited are two different battles, and most content loses the first one.

### 075. 重排序（Reranking）

模型阅读前，对检索候选项进行第二轮评分，按相关性重新排序。重排器比初次检索更准确，也更昂贵；处于边缘的内容往往在这里被淘汰。

**英文原文**

A second scoring pass that reorders retrieved candidates by relevance before the model reads them. Rerankers are more accurate and more expensive than the initial retrieval, and they're where borderline content gets cut.

### 076. 双编码器（Bi-encoder）

分别对查询和文档生成嵌入表示的检索模型，速度快，但结果是近似的。它负责对数百万份文档的第一轮筛选。

**英文原文**

A retrieval model that embeds the query and the document separately, which is fast and approximate. It handles the first pass over millions of documents.

### 077. 交叉编码器（Cross-encoder）

同时读取查询和文档，以获得更准确相关性评分的模型。速度慢、精度高，通常用于对排名靠前的候选项重新排序。

**英文原文**

A model that reads the query and document together for a more accurate relevance score. Slow, precise, and typically used for reranking the top candidates.

### 078. 综合生成（Synthesis）

模型根据多个检索来源写出一个答案的步骤。你精心设计的品牌定位，会在这里被压缩成半个分句，可能准确，也可能不准确。

**英文原文**

The step where the model writes one answer from multiple retrieved sources. Synthesis is where your carefully worded positioning gets compressed into half a clause, accurately or otherwise.

### 079. 位置偏差（Position bias）

模型往往赋予上下文开头和末尾的信息比中间更高的权重。研究将其称为“迷失在中间”效应，这也为把关键主张放在最前面提供了实际依据。

**英文原文**

The tendency of models to weigh information at the beginning and end of their context more heavily than the middle. Documented as the ["lost in the middle"](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172>) effect, and a practical argument for putting your key claim first.

### 080. 大语言模型评审（LLM-as-a-judge）

用一个模型大规模评估另一个模型的输出。大多数 AI 可见度和情感评分都建立在这种方法上，因此阅读供应商的情感分数时，应了解这一点。

**英文原文**

Using one model to evaluate another model's output at scale. Most AI visibility and sentiment scoring is built this way, which is worth knowing when you read a vendor's sentiment number.

### 081. 幻觉（Hallucination）

自信、流畅却错误的输出，包括从未有任何来源作出的关于公司的主张。监测它如今是品牌保护的一部分，而不只是满足好奇心。

**英文原文**

Confident, fluent, false output, including claims about your company that no source ever made. Monitoring for it is now part of brand protection rather than a curiosity.

### 082. 引用召回率（Citation recall）

生成句子中，实际得到所引用来源支持的比例。一项被广泛引用的 2023 年研究测得该比例为 51.5%，却经常被误传为“51.5% 的 AI 答案是错误的”。

**英文原文**

The share of generated sentences that are actually supported by the sources cited. A widely cited [2023 study](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.09848>) measured 51.5%, which is frequently and wrongly repeated as "51.5% of AI answers are wrong."

### 083. 引用忠实度（Citation faithfulness）

被引用来源是否真的说了答案声称它说的内容。忠实度低，意味着你即使被引用，仍可能被歪曲描述，而可见度指标发现不了这种问题。

**英文原文**

Whether a cited source says what the answer claims it says. Low faithfulness means you can be cited and still misrepresented, which no visibility metric will catch.

### 084. 潜在意图（Latent intent）

问题背后、提问者并未明确输入的需求。答案引擎会将提示词扇出到深层需求，因此只匹配输入字面的内容，会错过引擎实际执行的搜索。

**英文原文**

The need behind a question that the person never typed. Answer Engines fan a prompt out to the need underneath it, so content that matches only the typed words misses the searches the engine actually runs.


## 4. 提示词与查询行为／Prompts and query behavior

### 085. 提示词清单（Prompt list）

你明确选择并追踪的一组问题，因为它们就是买家会问的问题。选择清单是 AEO 项目中影响最大的决策，而多数团队却草率处理。

**英文原文**

The defined set of questions you track because they're the ones your buyers ask. Choosing this list is the highest-leverage decision in an AEO program, and most teams rush it.

### 086. 品牌提示词（Branded prompt）

明确提到公司或产品的提示词，例如“Profound 是最好的 AI 分析软件吗？”它测试的是模型如何看待你，而不是模型是否知道你存在。

**英文原文**

A prompt that names your company or product, such as "is Profound the best AI analytics software?" Branded prompts test what the models believe about you, not whether they know you exist.

### 087. 非品牌提示词（Unbranded prompt）

不提公司名称、只讨论问题或品类的提示词，例如“最佳 AI 分析软件”。短名单在这里形成，可见度也在这里赢得或失去。

**英文原文**

A prompt about a problem or category that names no company, such as "best AI analytics software." This is where shortlists get formed and where visibility is won or lost.

### 088. 比较型提示词（Comparative prompt）

要求 AI 比较指定选项的提示词。答案相当于一份即时分析报告，由模型已经学会信任的内容拼合而成。

**英文原文**

A prompt asking the AI to weigh named options against each other. The answer functions as an instant analyst report assembled from whatever content the model has learned to trust.

### 089. 买家旅程提示词（Buyer-journey prompts）

买家从早期学习到最终评估所问的完整问题序列。在学习类提示词中出现的品牌，进入比较阶段时往往已成为默认的优先选择。

**英文原文**

The full sequence of questions a buyer asks from early education through final evaluation. Brands that show up in the educational prompts tend to enter the comparison stage as the presumed favorite.

### 090. 商业提示词（Commercial prompt）

具有明确购买意图的提示词，例如询问最佳选项或寻求推荐。Profound 分析 2025 年至 2026 年中期的 750 万次 ChatGPT 对话发现，商业对话占比从 13.9% 升至 19.2%。这条趋势线让 AEO 成为与收入有关的话题。

**英文原文**

A prompt with clear buying intent, such as asking for the best option or a recommendation. Profound found [commercial conversations rose from 13.9% to 19.2%](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/commercial-conversations-in-chatgpt-more-than-doubled-in-a-year>) of ChatGPT's mix across 7.5 million conversations between 2025 and mid-2026, which is the trend line that makes AEO a revenue conversation.

### 091. 交易型提示词（Transactional prompt）

旨在完成某项行动，而非了解信息的提示词。智能体商务正是为完成这些提示词所指向的交易而构建的。

**英文原文**

A prompt aimed at completing an action rather than learning something. These are the prompts agentic commerce is being built to close.

### 092. 导航型提示词（Navigational prompt）

用户已经知道自己想去哪里时发出的提示词。它在总体中占比很小，也是最容易成为显而易见答案的一类。

**英文原文**

A prompt where the user already knows where they want to go. Small as a share of volume, and the one category where being the obvious answer is easy.

### 093. 信息型提示词（Informational prompt）

寻求理解而非购买的提示词。它是内容团队可覆盖的最大类别，也是最容易在没有点击的情况下被回答的类别。

**英文原文**

A prompt seeking understanding rather than a purchase. It's the largest addressable category for content teams and the one most likely to be answered without a click.

### 094. 生成型提示词（Generative prompt）

要求模型创作某物，而非寻找某物的提示词。Profound 测得，它是 ChatGPT 最大的单一意图类别，占 37.5%。这提醒我们，不应把每个提示词都当成搜索。

**英文原文**

A prompt asking the model to make something rather than find something. Profound [measured this as the single largest intent category](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/chatgpt-intent-landmark-study>) in ChatGPT at 37.5%, which is a useful corrective to treating every prompt as a search.

### 095. 提示词需求量（Prompt volume）

某个提示词代表的真实搜索需求有多大。供应商对这个词有两种用法：有时指依据用户样本推算的消费者需求，有时只指工具对该提示词抽样运行了多少次。务必问清；Profound 的 Prompt Volumes 指前者。

**英文原文**

How much real-world search demand a given prompt represents. Note that vendors use this phrase two ways, sometimes meaning panel-derived consumer demand and sometimes just meaning how many times a tool sampled the prompt, so always ask which; Profound's [Prompt Volumes](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/prompt-volumes>) means the former.

### 096. 提示词空间（Prompt space）

围绕你的品类提问的所有可能表达方式。无法全部追踪，所以关键是选择有代表性的样本，而不是选择对自己有利的样本。

**英文原文**

The full universe of ways a question can be asked about your category. You can't track all of it, so the discipline is choosing a representative sample rather than a flattering one.

### 097. 提示词聚类（Prompt clustering）

把语义相似的提示词分组，从而衡量一个主题，而非上百种措辞。这能防止把噪声当成变化来汇报。

**英文原文**

Grouping semantically similar prompts so you can measure a topic instead of a hundred phrasings. It's how you stop reporting noise as movement.

### 098. 提示词工程（Prompt engineering）

设计输入，以获得更好的模型输出。在营销中，它主要指建立提示词集合，用于审计模型如何描述品牌。

**英文原文**

Designing inputs to get better outputs from a model. In marketing it mostly describes building the prompt sets used to audit how models describe your brand.

### 099. 提示词追踪（Prompt tracking）

按固定计划，在不同 AI 平台运行一组固定提示词，衡量可见度、引用、情感和准确性。没有计划，只有零散个案；有了计划，就有可辩护的基线。这是 Profound Answer Engine Insights 的核心。

**英文原文**

Running a fixed set of prompts across AI platforms on a schedule to measure visibility, citations, sentiment and accuracy. Without a schedule you have anecdotes, and with one you have a baseline you can defend. This is the core of Profound’s [Answer Engine Insights](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights>).

### 100. 用户画像（Personas）

配置被追踪的提示词，使其体现特定买家类型、地区或语境。采购负责人与开发者问同一问题，可能得到不同品牌；把它们平均起来会掩盖发现。

**英文原文**

Configuring the tracked prompt to reflect a specific buyer type, region or context. The same question from a procurement lead and a developer can return different brands, and averaging them hides the finding.

### 101. 搜索变异（Search variation）

同一提示词重复运行时，系统检索到的来源发生变化。它不同于答案变异，也是引用指标同样需要抽样的原因。

**英文原文**

The difference in which sources a system retrieves across repeated runs of the same prompt. Distinct from answer variation, and the reason citation metrics need sampling too.

### 102. 执行次数（Execution）

某个被追踪提示词在某个平台上的一次单独运行。所有可见度百分比都以执行为原始计算单位，因此判断数字是否有意义时，执行数量很重要。

**英文原文**

One individual run of one tracked prompt against one platform. Executions are the raw unit that every visibility percentage is calculated from, so the count matters when judging whether a number is meaningful.

### 103. 发现型提示词（Discovery prompt）

不点名任何品牌，要求在你的品类中给出推荐的提示词。它最能清楚反映哪些因素在塑造品类格局。

**英文原文**

A prompt that asks for a recommendation in your category without naming any brand. It gives the cleanest read of what is shaping your category.

### 104. 验证型提示词（Validation prompt）

检查 AI 是否知道你具备某项能力的提示词。当发现阶段显示某项属性可见度较低时，就运行它。

**英文原文**

A prompt that checks whether AI understands you have a specific capability at all. Run it when discovery shows low visibility for that attribute.

### 105. 市场认知提示词（Market perception prompt）

要求 AI 描述产品品类，并解释如何评估，但不提任何品牌的提示词。它展示买家被告知的选择标准，是否有利于你的长处。

**英文原文**

A prompt that asks AI to describe your product category and explain how to evaluate it, without naming any brands. It shows whether the way buyers are told to choose favors what you're good at.

### 106. 复合任务提示词（Compound-job prompt）

由一个基础任务——买家试图完成的核心工作——加上使其具体化的限定条件组成的提示词。这是真实买家问题的形态；Profound 101 称其为带多个限定条件的复合提示词。

**英文原文**

A prompt built from a base, the core job a buyer is trying to get done, plus the qualifiers that make it specific. It's the shape real buyer questions take, which Profound 101 calls a compound prompt with multiple qualifiers.

### 107. 竞争对手提示词（Competitor prompt）

把问题收窄到两个指定品牌，询问谁更胜一筹的提示词。它需要具体使用场景、两个品牌名称，以及明确的推荐请求，否则 AI 往往回避选择、模棱两可。

**英文原文**

A prompt that asks who wins when the question narrows to two named brands. It needs a specific use case, both brands by name, and an explicit ask for a recommendation, or AI tends to hedge instead of picking one.

### 108. 准确性提示词（Accuracy prompt）

检查 AI 对产品的描述是否符合事实，包括它提到的规格、定价、集成和能力。只有你掌握书面事实、能据以核对答案时，它才有效。

**英文原文**

A prompt that asks whether AI's description of your product is factually correct, including the specs, pricing, integrations and capabilities it brings up. It only works when you hold documented facts to check the answer against.

### 109. 情感提示词（Sentiment prompt）

要求 AI 评估你、列出优缺点，而非罗列品牌的提示词。应按属性标记每个问题，读取各项能力的信号，而不是用一个混合分数掩盖真实信号。

**英文原文**

A prompt that asks AI to evaluate you, with pros and cons, instead of listing brands. Tag each one by attribute so you read a signal per capability, not one blended score that hides the real signal.

### 110. 深度主题（Depth topic）

为赢得特定机会而建立的专门、细粒度主题。Profound 101 建议设置 2—5 个，每个对应一项战略重点，并相互分开，因为主题数据会汇总；把不同重点混在一起会削弱诊断能力。宽泛主题在 Profound 101 中称为覆盖主题，用于监测整个品类。

**英文原文**

A dedicated, granular topic built to win a specific opportunity. Profound 101 recommends two to five, one for each strategic priority, and keeps them separate because topic data is aggregated, so mixing priorities into one topic loses diagnostic power. Broad topics, which Profound 101 calls coverage topics, monitor a whole category instead.

### 111. 覆盖充分度（Coverage）

一组足够有代表性、足够多样的提示词，使你能信任它们揭示的某项属性情况。目标是提示词空间的代表性样本，而不是所有可能措辞。它不同于覆盖主题，后者是 Profound 101 对监测一个品类的宽泛主题的称呼。

**英文原文**

A set of prompts that's representative and varied enough that you can trust what it tells you about an attribute. The goal is a representative sample of the prompt space, not every possible phrasing. Not the same as a coverage topic, which is Profound 101's name for a broad topic that monitors a category.

### 112. 信任问题（Trust problem）

AI 知道你能做某件事，却不为此推荐你的差距。解决办法是外部信号：引用、第三方权威，以及站外描述。

**英文原文**

A gap where AI knows you can do something and just doesn't recommend you for it. The fix is external signal: citations, third-party authority and off-page descriptions.

### 113. 理解问题（Comprehension problem）

AI 不知道你具备某项能力的差距。解决办法是在自有渠道上更清楚地描述，并以结构化文档说明你做什么。

**英文原文**

A gap where AI doesn't know you have a capability. The fix is clearer descriptions on your own surfaces and structured documentation of what you do.


## 5. 引用与来源／Citations and sources

### 114. 引用（Citation）

AI 工具提供的、指向某个网站的参考链接。引用揭示引擎在你的品类中信任什么内容，因此是 AI 搜索产生的最便于指导行动的数据。Profound 的 Citations 视图将其分为自有、竞争对手、赢得的媒体、公关稿分发、社交和机构等类别。

**英文原文**

A reference an AI tool provides pointing back to a website. Citations reveal which content the engines trust in your category, which makes them the most actionable data AI Search produces. Profound's [Citations](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights/citations>) view sorts them into owned, competitor, earned media, PR wire, social and institutional buckets.

### 115. 来源（Source）

系统为构建答案而检索的任何页面或文档，不论它是否作为可见链接出现。检索过但未引用的来源，仍会塑造答案对你的描述。

**英文原文**

Any page or document the system retrieved to build the answer, whether or not it appears as a visible link. Retrieved-but-uncited sources still shape what the answer says about you.

### 116. 行内引用（Inline citation）

直接嵌在答案正文中的链接，通常紧邻它所支持的主张。相比底部来源清单，行内位置更能引起读者重视。

**英文原文**

A link embedded directly in the body of the answer, usually next to the claim it supports. Inline placement carries more weight with readers than the source list at the bottom.

### 117. 来源区块（Sources block）

与答案正文分开显示的参考来源清单。SE Ranking 发现，AI Overviews 中约 93% 的评价平台链接出现在这里，而非正文行内，因此大多数引用的可见程度低于品牌的想象。

**英文原文**

The list of references displayed separately from the answer text. [SE Ranking](<https://seranking.com/blog/review-platforms-in-ai-overviews/>) found roughly 93% of review-platform links in AI Overviews appeared here rather than inline, so most citations are less visible than brands assume.

### 118. 被引用域名（Cited domain）

出现在答案引用中的来源的根域名。把引用汇总到域名层面，就能看出谁真正掌握了这个品类的证据供给。

**英文原文**

The root domain of a source that appears in an answer's citations. Rolling citations up to domain level is how you see who really owns the category's supply of evidence.

### 119. 品牌提及（Brand mention）

AI 答案中任何一次点名品牌的情况，无论是否附链接。提及是声量份额的原始材料；没有链接的提及，也会影响候选短名单。

**英文原文**

Any instance of your brand being named in an AI answer, with or without a link. Mentions are the raw material of share of voice, and a mention without a link still moves a shortlist.

### 120. 真实品牌提及（Authentic brand mention）

在 AI 已经引用的来源中，关于品牌的准确、相关内容。这是站外 AEO 的工作单位，因为改善一个可信来源对你的描述，比让自己成为可信来源更快。

**英文原文**

Accurate, relevant content about your brand inside a source the AI already cites. This is the unit of work in offsite AEO, because improving what a trusted source says about you is faster than becoming a trusted source.

### 121. 新增提及（New mention）

让 AI 已为买家问题引用、但当前遗漏你的文章加入品牌。这是最具影响力的站外做法，因为该来源已经赢得了引用资格。

**英文原文**

Getting your brand added to an article the AI already cites for your buyers' questions but which currently omits you. It's the highest-leverage offsite play available, since the source has already earned the citation.

### 122. 提及更新（Mention refresh）

修正已有提及中不准确、过时或对品牌定位不利的内容。它比争取新增位置更便宜，而且通常更紧迫。

**英文原文**

Correcting an existing mention that's inaccurate, out of date, or positions you poorly. Cheaper than earning a new placement and usually more urgent.

### 123. 互惠提及（Reverse mention）

两个品牌同意在各自内容中提到对方的互惠安排。它有效，但需要仔细设计，避免看起来像链接操纵。

**英文原文**

A reciprocal arrangement where two brands agree to mention each other in their content. Effective, and worth structuring carefully so it doesn't read as a link scheme.

### 124. 共同引用（Co-citation）

与另一个品牌在同一答案中被引用。持续共同引用会让模型学会谁是你的竞争对手，也可能把你放进一个自己从未选择的比较集合。

**英文原文**

Being cited in the same answer as another brand. Persistent co-citation is how models learn who your competitors are, and it can put you in a comparison set you never chose.

### 125. 共现（Co-occurrence）

品牌与某个概念共同出现得足够频繁，使模型把二者关联起来。这是占据品类心智的机制，需要多个来源反复出现，而不是仅靠一个出色页面。

**英文原文**

Your brand and a concept appearing together often enough that the model associates them. It's the mechanism behind category ownership, and it's built through repetition across many sources rather than one great page.

### 126. 品牌自有来源引用（Brand-owned citation）

指向你所控制域名的引用。Profound 对 118.4 亿次引用的分析发现，AI 引用中指向某家公司自有网站的比例，中位数约为 57%；在 Gemini 上升至 69%。这意味着自有内容的重要性，高于“你无法控制它”这种说法所暗示的程度。

**英文原文**

A citation pointing to a domain you control. Profound's [analysis of 11.84 billion citations](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/where-do-ai-citations-come-from>) found a median of roughly 57% of AI citations point to some company's own website, rising to 69% on Gemini, which means owned content matters more than the "you can't control it" narrative suggests.

### 127. 赢得的第三方引用（Earned citation）

指向独立媒体、评价网站或第三方报道的引用。Profound 测得，该类来源在 ChatGPT 引用构成中的中位数约为 30%，在 AI Overviews 中为 17%，因此平台不同，构成差异明显。

**英文原文**

A citation pointing to independent media, review sites or third-party coverage. Profound [measured a median of about 30%](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/where-do-ai-citations-come-from>) of ChatGPT's citation mix and 17% in AI Overviews, so the balance shifts meaningfully by platform.

### 128. 社交来源引用（Social citation）

指向 Reddit、YouTube、LinkedIn 等社区或社交平台的引用。Profound 发现，社交来源在 AI Overviews 中约占 15%，在 AI Mode 中约占 14%；足以重视，但不足以单独支撑整个策略。

**英文原文**

A citation pointing to a community or social platform such as Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn. Profound [found social sources](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/where-do-ai-citations-come-from>) at roughly 15% in AI Overviews and 14% in AI Mode, which is enough to matter and not enough to build a strategy on alone.

### 129. 评价网站影响力（Review-site influence）

AI 答案给予 G2、Capterra、Gartner Peer Insights 和 Trustpilot 等平台的权重。SE Ranking 在 30,000 个美国商业意图关键词中发现，34.5% 的 AI Overviews 至少引用一个评价平台，按查询类型不同，比例从 17.1% 到 49% 不等。对于单一网站贡献多大，供应商看法不一。Kevin Indig 对 500 个 G2 品类的回归分析所依据的 Profound 数据表明，评价与引用之间确有关系，但关系较弱。

**英文原文**

The weight AI answers give to platforms like G2, Capterra, Gartner Peer Insights and Trustpilot. [SE Ranking](<https://seranking.com/blog/review-platforms-in-ai-overviews/>) found 34.5% of AI Overviews on 30,000 US commercial-intent keywords cited at least one review platform, ranging from 17.1% to 49% by query type, and vendors disagree on how much any single site contributes. Profound data behind [Kevin Indig's regression across 500 G2 categories](<https://learn.g2.com/do-more-g2-reviews-mean-more-ai-visibility>) found the reviews-to-citations relationship real but weak.

### 130. 回答（Response）

AI 搜索引擎针对一个提示词返回的完整答案。其他指标都以它为计算范围，因此，任何衡量项目的第一步都是先约定什么算一次回答。

**英文原文**

The complete answer an AI Search engine returns for one prompt. It's the container every other metric is calculated against, so agreeing on what counts as one response is step one of any measurement program.

### 131. 行内引用域名（Inline domain）

直接嵌在答案正文中的链接的根域名，与来源区块中列出的域名相区别。区分两者，可以看出哪些网站受信任到被直接援引，而不只是列入参考清单。

**英文原文**

The root domain of a link embedded directly in the answer text, as opposed to one listed in the sources block. Separating inline from sources-block domains tells you which sites are trusted enough to be quoted rather than filed.

### 132. 引用差距（Citation gap）

AI 引用竞争对手、却不引用你的提示词和主题。这是 AI 搜索衡量中最能直接指导行动的产出，因为它其实是一份以报告形式呈现的待办清单。Profound 在 Answer Engine Insights 中展示这些差距。

**英文原文**

Prompts and topics where AI engines cite your competitors but not you. This is the most directly actionable output of AI Search measurement, because it's a to-do list disguised as a report. Profound surfaces these in [Answer Engine Insights](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights>).

### 133. 引用增长速度（Citation velocity）

来源随时间累积引用的速度。应谨慎看待相关说法，因为至少三家供应商的定义彼此不兼容，也没有主流平台把它作为标准字段提供。

**英文原文**

How quickly a source accumulates citations over time. Treat claims about it carefully, since at least three vendors define it incompatibly and no major platform exposes it as a standard field.

### 134. 引用劫持（Citation hijacking）

答案把你的内容、数据或主张归到其他来源名下。你付出的工作并没有减少，却失去了应得的认可。原因通常是别人以更容易抓取的形式重新发布了你的内容。

**英文原文**

When an answer attributes your content, data or claim to a different source. It costs you the credit without reducing the effort, and it usually traces back to someone else republishing you more crawlably.

### 135. 引用供应链（Citation supply chain）

某个 AI 平台在回答特定主题时使用的域名和来源类型的排名清单。它解释了为什么同一问题在不同平台上得到不同来源，也指出站外投入在哪里才能真正被读到。

**英文原文**

The ranked list of domains and source types that a specific AI platform pulls from when answering a given topic. It explains why the same question returns different sources on different platforms, and it shows where off-site effort would actually be read.


## 6. 衡量方法与指标／Measurement and metrics

### 136. 可见度（Visibility）

品牌是否出现在某个 AI 答案中，计算口径是：在所有提到任何品牌的答案里，提到你的品牌的答案所占比例。Profound 将其定义为二元指标，因此同一回答提到一次和五次计分相同。另见出现率和答案纳入率，它们在不同范围内描述同一个概念。

**英文原文**

Whether your brand appeared in a given AI answer, measured as the share of answers that mention your brand, out of answers that mention any brand. [Profound defines it as a binary metric](<https://help.tryprofound.com/articles/9363559589-profound-glossary>), so appearing once and appearing five times in the same response count the same. See also Presence rate and Answer inclusion rate, which describe the same idea at different scopes.

### 137. 可见度分数（Visibility score）

汇总品牌在被追踪提示词中可被找到程度的单一数字。在 Profound 中，它是提到品牌的被追踪答案的占比；其他供应商可能报告混合出现情况、排名和突出程度的综合分数，所以仅看名称无法判断含义。

**英文原文**

A single number summarizing how findable you are across your tracked prompts. In Profound, it's the share of tracked answers that mentioned your brand, though other vendors report a composite blending presence, position and prominence, so the label alone tells you nothing.

### 138. 出现率（Presence rate）

被追踪回答中，品牌至少出现一次的比例。它是最清晰、最不易操纵的可见度指标，也适合作为管理层汇报的默认指标。一些供应商称它为品牌出现率。另见可见度和答案纳入率。

**英文原文**

The share of tracked responses where your brand appears at least once. The cleanest and least manipulable visibility metric, and a good default for executive reporting. Some vendors call this brand presence. See also Visibility and Answer inclusion rate.

### 139. 品牌认知（Brand perception）

AI 答案如何刻画你的品牌：使用哪些形容词、将你放入什么类别、关联哪些使用场景。它超越情感倾向，因为一个答案即使对你评价正面，也可能描述出一家你自己都不认识的公司。

**英文原文**

How AI answers characterize your brand: the adjectives, the category they place you in, and the use cases they attach to you. It goes beyond sentiment, because an answer can be positive about you and still describe a company you don't recognize.

### 140. 提及频次（Mention frequency）

品牌被点名的次数，包括同一答案中的重复提及。它不同于可见度，有助于识别那些由你主导、而不只是有你出现的答案。

**英文原文**

A count of how many times your brand is named, including multiple mentions within a single answer. Distinct from visibility, and useful for spotting answers where you dominate rather than merely appear.

### 141. 声量份额（Share of voice）

在被追踪提示词产生的全部品牌提及中，你相对于所有竞争对手所占的份额。应把它当成比例而不是次数，因为即使某个月你的实际可见度上升，两位新进入者也可能让你的百分比下降。参见 Profound 的定义与计算示例。

**英文原文**

Your share of all brand mentions across your tracked prompts, compared against every competitor. Read it as a share and not a count, because two new entrants can shrink your percentage in a month where your actual visibility rose. See [Profound's definition and worked example](<https://help.tryprofound.com/articles/9363559589-profound-glossary>).

### 142. 引用份额（Citation share）

特定页面或域名被引用的次数占全部引用的比例。Profound 以所有引用为计算范围；可以按页面或域名层面解读，而不同层级会显著改变数值。

**英文原文**

How often a specific page or domain is cited as a proportion of all citations. [Profound measures it across all citations](<https://help.tryprofound.com/articles/9363559589-profound-glossary>), and it can be read at either page or domain level, which changes the number substantially.

### 143. 来源份额（Share of sources）

一组答案的全部来源中，来自某一域名的百分比。它与引用份额的思路相近，经常被用作同义词；只要不在同一图表里混用，两者互称并无大碍。

**英文原文**

The percentage of all sources in a set of answers that come from one domain. Similar in spirit to citation share and frequently used as a synonym, which is fine as long as you don't mix the two in one chart.

### 144. 品牌排名（Brand position）

相对于同一答案中其他被点名品牌的次序。十个品牌中排第四，与排第一并不是同样的结果，而只衡量出现与否的指标会抹去这一差异。

**英文原文**

Your rank relative to other brands named in the same answer. Being mentioned fourth in a list of ten isn't the same result as being mentioned first, and presence-only metrics erase that distinction.

### 145. 品牌出现位置（Brand placement）

品牌在答案中首次出现得有多早，常以正文的十分位位置表示。越早出现，实际看到它的读者越多，因为多数人不会读完整个答案。

**英文原文**

How early in the answer your brand first appears, often expressed as a decile of the text. Earlier placement means more readers actually see it, since most people don't finish the answer.

### 146. 突出程度（Prominence）

综合考察排名、出现位置和答案有多少篇幅讨论你。加入突出程度之后，AEO 报告才开始像真正的竞争指标，而不只是勾选“出现过”的复选框。

**英文原文**

A combined read on position, placement and how much of the answer is about you. Prominence is where AEO reporting starts to resemble a real competitive metric instead of a checkbox.

### 147. 提及深度（Depth of mention）

答案对品牌的讨论有多实质，而不只是报出名字。一句准确的定位描述，胜过在逗号分隔的清单里露面；目前尚无统一计算公式。

**英文原文**

How substantively the answer discusses your brand rather than just naming it. A sentence of accurate positioning beats an appearance in a comma-separated list, and no standard formula for this exists yet.

### 148. 首次提及率（First-mention rate）

品牌成为答案中第一个被点名品牌的频率。它是衡量品牌是否成为品类默认选择的有力替代指标。

**英文原文**

How often you're the first brand named in an answer. A strong proxy for default-choice status in a category.

### 149. 情感倾向（Sentiment）

答案以正面、负面还是中立方式描述品牌，通常分别报告百分比。由于模型压缩了网络各处的意见，AI 情感是对品牌声誉的提炼，而不是一次声誉调查。Profound 将其作为 Sentiment 追踪。

**英文原文**

Whether an answer portrays your brand positively, negatively or neutrally, usually reported as a percentage for each. Because models compress opinion from across the web, AI sentiment is a distilled reading of your reputation rather than a survey of it. Profound tracks it as [Sentiment](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights/sentiment>).

### 150. 汇总情感分数（Aggregated sentiment score）

在被追踪答案中，正面情感出现次数与所有情感出现次数之比，这是 Profound 的计算方法。作为趋势线很有用，但作为绝对数值不够稳固，因为评分通常由另一个模型完成。

**英文原文**

The ratio of positive sentiment occurrences to all sentiment occurrences across your tracked answers, which is [how Profound calculates it](<https://help.tryprofound.com/articles/9363559589-profound-glossary>). Useful as a trend line, and shaky as an absolute number, because it's typically scored by another model.

### 151. 情感漂移（Sentiment drift）

模型对你的描述随时间逐渐变化。漂移通常可追溯到某个来源改变，或新来源进入引用池，因此它可以诊断，并非神秘现象。

**英文原文**

A gradual shift in how models characterize you over time. Drift usually traces to a specific source changing or a new one entering the citation pool, which makes it diagnosable rather than mysterious.

### 152. 准确性分数（Accuracy score）

将真实定价、定位和产品详情，与 AI 实际描述进行比较所得的百分比。这一指标使 AEO 从营销练习变成品牌风险管理；Profound 的 FactCheck 正是为衡量它而建立的。

**英文原文**

A percentage comparing your real pricing, positioning and product details against what AI actually says about you. It's the metric that turns AEO from a marketing exercise into a brand-risk one, and it's what Profound built [FactCheck](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights/factcheck>) to measure.

### 153. 答案纳入率（Answer inclusion rate）

某个主题的答案中包含品牌的比例。它实际上是限定范围的出现率；由于缺乏跨供应商标准，应明确写出定义。另见可见度和出现率。

**英文原文**

The share of answers for a topic that include your brand. Effectively a scoped presence rate, and worth defining explicitly since no cross-vendor standard exists. See also Visibility and Presence rate.

### 154. 竞争重叠度（Competitive overlap）

你与某个特定竞争对手出现在同一答案中的频率。高度重叠意味着双方正在被直接比较，无论销售团队是否这样界定竞争。Profound 的 AI 购物旅程研究发现，最终被选择的品牌声量份额为 24%，被放弃的品牌为 11%。

**英文原文**

How often you and a specific competitor appear in the same answers. High overlap means you're being evaluated head-to-head whether or not your sales team frames it that way. Profound's study of AI shopping journeys found [chosen brands held 24% share of voice against 11% for passed-over brands](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/the-shortlist-is-the-new-shelf>).

### 155. 来源可见度（Source visibility）

某个域名随时间在一组 AI 答案中出现的频率。决定哪些第三方网站值得投入公关预算时，应关注这一指标。

**英文原文**

How often a given domain appears across a set of AI answers over time. This is the metric to watch when deciding which third-party sites deserve your PR budget.

### 156. 展示量（Impressions）

对一次提及实际获得多少曝光的估计，通常按搜索量为提及加权。各家定义差异巨大，至少一家主要供应商使用 Google 搜索量作为权重输入，因此它是混合指标，而非纯 AI 指标。

**英文原文**

An estimate of how much exposure a mention actually received, usually by weighting mentions against search volume. Definitions vary enormously, and at least one major vendor uses Google search volume as the weighting input, which makes it a hybrid rather than a pure AI metric.

### 157. 位置调整词数（PAWC）（Position-Adjusted Word Count (PAWC)）

一项学术指标：计算答案中可归因于某来源的词数，并按这些词所处位置加权。它来自最初的 GEO 论文，该论文于 2023 年发布预印本、后发表于 KDD 2024；它仍是已发表研究中衡量答案份额最严谨的尝试。

**英文原文**

An academic metric counting how many words of an answer are attributable to a source, weighted by where they sit. It comes from the [original GEO paper](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09735>), a 2023 preprint published at KDD 2024, and remains the most rigorous published attempt at measuring answer share.

### 158. 抓取与引荐比（Crawl-to-refer ratio）

AI 公司每送回一位访客，会抓取你的网站多少次。Cloudflare 在 2025 年的测量显示，不同运营方之间差异巨大；这一比例已成为出版商补偿争论中的核心证据。

**英文原文**

How many times an AI company crawls your site for every visitor it sends back. [Cloudflare's 2025 measurements](<https://radar.cloudflare.com/ai-insights>) showed enormous spreads by operator, and the ratio has become the central exhibit in the publisher-compensation argument.

### 159. 数据清洗（Data cleansing）

计算指标前，过滤重复、格式异常或不具代表性的回答。这项工作不起眼，却决定基线是可信还是充满噪声。

**英文原文**

Filtering out duplicate, malformed or non-representative responses before calculating metrics. Unglamorous, and the difference between a trustworthy baseline and a noisy one.

### 160. 页面与域名口径（Pages versus domains）

选择把引用归因到具体 URL，还是根域名。按域名汇总会让大型出版商看起来占据主导；按页面查看，则能告诉你该去修正哪一篇具体文章。

**英文原文**

The choice of whether to attribute a citation to the specific URL or the root domain. Domain-level rollups make big publishers look dominant and page-level views show you which specific article to go fix.

### 161. 答案波动性（Answer volatility）

在底层没有任何变化时，测得的可见度在不同抽样轮次之间摆动的程度。先建立自身的波动区间，才能避免把噪声报告成胜利。

**英文原文**

How much your measured visibility swings between sampling runs without any underlying change. Establishing your volatility band first is what stops you from reporting noise as a win.

### 162. 可见度排名（Visibility rank）

对于某个提示词或主题，品牌按可见度分数相对竞争对手的排名。它是 Profound AEO 指南中的核心项目指标，能显示你在竞争群体中的位置，这是单一分数做不到的。

**英文原文**

Your brand's rank by visibility score relative to competitors for a prompt or topic. It's the headline program metric in Profound's AEO Guide, and it shows where you stand against the field, which a score alone can't.

### 163. 引用排名（Citation rank）

把被引用来源按引用份额排序时，某域名或页面的名次。数字越小，表示该来源比同类来源更常被引用。

**英文原文**

The rank of a domain or page when cited sources are sorted by citation share. A lower number means the source is cited more often than its peers.

### 164. 答案引擎洞察（Answer Engine Insights）（Answer Engine Insights）

Profound 用于衡量品牌在不同答案引擎中如何出现的产品，涵盖可见度、引用、情感和准确性。它把一组被追踪提示词转化为其余 AEO 工作所依据的基线。

**英文原文**

Profound's product for measuring how brands appear across Answer Engines: visibility, citations, sentiment and accuracy. It turns a set of tracked prompts into the baseline the rest of an AEO program works from.

### 165. 事实核查（FactCheck）（FactCheck）

Profound 的准确性检查层，属于 Answer Engine Insights。FactCheck 提取答案引擎对品牌作出的主张，逐项与知识库核对，按主题聚类，并将不准确主张追溯到促成它们的引用 URL。

**英文原文**

Profound's accuracy layer, part of Answer Engine Insights. FactCheck extracts the claims Answer Engines make about your brand, checks each against your Knowledge Base, clusters them by theme, and traces inaccurate claims back to the citation URLs driving them.

### 166. 机会（Opportunity）

你表现不足、但有理由应该出现的属性。在审计卡上，它表现为高优先级属性的低可见度：优先级一的差距进入行动清单；同样差距若发生在优先级三的属性上，就只是一个数据点。

**英文原文**

An attribute where you underperform but have reason to show up. On the audit card, that's low visibility on a high-priority attribute: a priority-one gap goes on the action list, while the same gap on a priority-three attribute is just a data point.

### 167. 异议（Objection）

AI 答案对品牌反复呈现、而你需要回应的负面模式。它是 AI 持续指出的产品弱点。

**英文原文**

A recurring negative pattern in AI answers about your brand that you need to counter. It's a weakness AI keeps surfacing about your product.

### 168. 优势（Strength）

AI 已经准确且正面反映你的属性。它是值得加倍投入的基础，而不是待修复的问题。

**英文原文**

An attribute where AI is already reflecting you accurately and favorably. It's the foundation you double down on rather than fix.

### 169. AEO 审计（AEO audit）

在每个相关答案引擎中，系统检查每项属性。它产生机会、异议、优势三份清单；审计止于呈现现状，而非制定计划，后续行动以这些清单为依据。

**英文原文**

A systematic pass through every attribute, across every relevant Answer Engine. It produces three lists (opportunities, objections and strengths), and it ends at the picture rather than the plan: the lists are what you act on.

### 170. 广泛异议（Broad objection）

跨许多属性出现、因此需要全面修正的异议。在决定行动位置前，先检查负面主题是广泛存在，还是局限于某些提示词，并关注趋势方向：持续上升意味着紧急，稳定则意味着可以长期管理。

**英文原文**

An objection that appears across many attributes, so it needs a broad fix. Check whether a negative theme is broad or confined to certain prompts before deciding where to act, and watch the direction: trending upward means urgent, while stable means you manage it over time.

### 171. 特定异议（Specific objection）

只与某些提示词相关、因此需要定向回应的异议。它是负面模式局部化的情况，所以决定在哪里修正之前，要先检查主题是广泛还是特定。

**英文原文**

An objection tied to certain prompts only, so it needs a targeted response. It's the confined case of a negative pattern, which is why you check whether a theme is broad or specific before deciding where to fix it.

### 172. 主题（Theme）

AI 描述品牌时不断出现的词语或概念。情感分数告诉你 AI 的语气是正面还是负面，主题则告诉你为什么。

**英文原文**

A word or idea that keeps coming up when AI describes your brand. A sentiment score tells you whether AI sounds positive or negative about you, and themes tell you why.

### 173. 现实问题（Reality problem）

AI 准确描述了产品，而人们不喜欢看到的内容。这是产品或定价问题，做再多内容工作也修不好。

**英文原文**

A reading where AI describes your product accurately and people don't like what they read. It's a product or pricing conversation, and no amount of content work fixes it.

### 174. 认知问题（Perception problem）

产品本身没有问题，但 AI 获取的来源讲错了故事。与现实问题不同，它可以通过内容和站外工作修正。因此应检查某个负面主题是在多个独立来源反复出现，还是只来自一条论坛帖子。

**英文原文**

A reading where the product is fine, and the sources AI pulls from are telling the wrong story about it. Unlike a reality problem, it's fixable with content and off-page work, so check whether a negative theme repeats across many independent sources or comes from a single forum thread.


## 7. 平台与使用界面／Platforms and surfaces

### 175. AI 概览（AI Overviews）（AI Overviews）

Google 在传统搜索结果上方展示的 AI 生成摘要，由多个来源综合而成。Google 在 2026 年 5 月报告月用户超过 25 亿；Pew 发现，有 AI 摘要时，8% 的访问会点击传统结果，没有摘要时则为 15%。

**英文原文**

Google's AI-generated summary above the traditional results, assembled from multiple sources. Google reported more than 2.5 billion monthly users in May 2026, and [Pew found people clicked a traditional result in 8% of visits with an AI summary against 15% without](<https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2025/07/22/google-users-are-less-likely-to-click-on-links-when-an-ai-summary-appears-in-the-results/>).

### 176. AI 模式（AI Mode）（AI Mode）

Google 的完整对话式搜索体验，以追问取代重新搜索，以引用来源取代十条蓝色链接。Google 在 2026 年 5 月报告其月用户超过 10 亿，但独立测量表明实际查询份额仍很小。

**英文原文**

Google's full conversational search experience, where follow-ups replace new searches and cited sources replace the ten blue links. Google reported it passing one billion monthly users in May 2026, though independent measurement suggests actual query share remains small.

### 177. 搜索生成式体验（SGE）（SGE (Search Generative Experience)）

Google 在 2023 年 5 月宣布的 Search Labs 实验，在 2024 年 5 月 AI Overviews 正式公开上线后被取代。旧策略演示文稿中提到它时，可理解为今天的 AI Overviews。

**英文原文**

Google's Search Labs experiment, announced in May 2023 and superseded when AI Overviews launched publicly in May 2024. Treat any reference to it in an older strategy deck as today's AI Overviews.

### 178. ChatGPT（ChatGPT）

OpenAI 的助手，也是 AI 搜索中最大的单一使用界面。OpenAI 报告，截至 2026 年 8 月使用人数超过 10 亿；最近一次公布的周活跃数字为 2025 年 10 月的 8 亿。网页搜索如今会自动发生，不再是独立模式，因此 ChatGPT 与“ChatGPT Search”的旧区别实际上已经消失。

**英文原文**

OpenAI's assistant and the largest single surface in AI Search, with OpenAI reporting more than a billion people using it as of August 2026 and a last-published weekly-active figure of 800 million in October 2025. Web search is now automatic rather than a separate mode, so the old distinction between ChatGPT and "ChatGPT Search" has effectively dissolved.

### 179. ChatGPT Atlas（ChatGPT Atlas）

OpenAI 的浏览器，于 2025 年推出、2026 年 8 月关闭。了解它的主要意义，是能判断仍把它列入其中的策略演示文稿有多陈旧。

**英文原文**

OpenAI's browser, launched in 2025 and shut down in August 2026. Worth knowing only so you can date any strategy deck that still features it.

### 180. Gemini（Gemini）

Google 的助手，前身是 Bard；2026 年 8 月报告月活跃用户超过 10 亿。其引用构成异常偏重品牌自有来源，因此你自己的网站在这里格外重要。

**英文原文**

Google's assistant, formerly Bard, reported at over one billion monthly active users in August 2026. Its citation mix skews unusually heavily toward brand-owned sources, which makes your own site disproportionately valuable there.

### 181. Perplexity（Perplexity）

围绕透明来源构建的答案引擎，因此受到希望查看引用的用户喜爱。相对 ChatGPT 和 Gemini，它的流量份额很小；但在 AEO 讨论中的存在感，始终超过其实际规模。

**英文原文**

An Answer Engine built around transparent sourcing, which made it the favorite of people who wanted to see the citations. Small in traffic share relative to ChatGPT and Gemini, and consistently over-indexed in AEO discourse relative to its size.

### 182. Comet（Comet）

Perplexity 的智能体浏览器。它是浏览器本身成为智能体，而非只是展示智能体的窗口的早期例子。

**英文原文**

Perplexity's agentic browser. Notable as an early example of the browser itself becoming the agent rather than a window onto one.

### 183. Microsoft Copilot（Microsoft Copilot）

微软在 Bing、Windows 和 Office 中提供的助手。它对 AEO 的实际重要性在于企业覆盖范围，而非消费者查询量。

**英文原文**

Microsoft's assistant across Bing, Windows and Office. Its practical AEO importance is enterprise reach rather than consumer query volume.

### 184. Copilot Search（Copilot Search）

微软在 Bing 内的 AI 答案体验，有时仍被称为 Bing Copilot。Bing Webmaster Tools 提供其他平台未公开提供的 AI 相关数据，因此其实用价值超过其市场份额所暗示的程度。

**英文原文**

Microsoft's AI answer experience inside Bing, sometimes still called Bing Copilot. Bing Webmaster Tools exposes AI-related data that no other platform offers publicly, which makes it useful out of proportion to its share.

### 185. Claude（Claude）

Anthropic 的助手，支持网页搜索。Anthropic 是唯一明确说明用户触发抓取不享有 robots.txt 豁免的主要运营方，因此屏蔽其机器人，就会让你退出它的答案。

**英文原文**

Anthropic's assistant, with web search available. Anthropic is the only major operator that documents no robots.txt exemption for user-triggered fetches, which means blocking its bots removes you from its answers.

### 186. Grok（Grok）

SpaceXAI 的助手，原属 xAI，后者于 2026 年 2 月被 SpaceX 收购。它与 X 紧密结合，答案对实时社交内容的依赖程度格外高。

**英文原文**

The assistant from SpaceXAI, formerly xAI, which SpaceX acquired in February 2026. Tightly coupled to X, and its answers lean unusually hard on real-time social content.

### 187. Meta AI（Meta AI）

嵌入 Meta 各应用的助手。名义覆盖范围巨大，引荐流量极少，并有一个专门为答案引用而设的独立爬虫。

**英文原文**

Meta's assistant that’s embedded across its apps. Enormous nominal reach, minimal referral traffic, and a separate crawler specifically for being cited in its answers.

### 188. DeepSeek（DeepSeek）

一家中国实验室，其高效的开放权重模型重塑了行业对成本的预期。它与 AEO 的主要关系在于：开放权重模型会被嵌入某些产品，而你永远不会被告知这些产品使用了它们。

**英文原文**

A Chinese lab whose efficient open-weight models reset industry cost expectations. Relevant to AEO mostly because open-weight models get embedded in products you'll never be told about.

### 189. 购物版 Alexa（Alexa for Shopping）（Alexa for Shopping）

Amazon 的购物助手，于 2026 年 5 月吸收原 Rufus，更广泛的任务则交给 Alexa+。Amazon 报告，仅 Rufus 在 2025 年就帮助超过 3 亿客户，因此这是大多数 B2C 品牌尚未衡量的最大 AI 使用界面。

**英文原文**

Amazon's shopping assistant, which absorbed the former Rufus in May 2026 and hands off to Alexa+ for broader tasks. Amazon reported Rufus alone helped over 300 million customers in 2025, making this the largest AI surface most B2C brands aren't measuring.

### 190. Apple Intelligence（Apple Intelligence）

Apple 的设备端 AI 层，包括重建后的 Siri AI。它对 AEO 的意义在于分发覆盖：它能接触到从不打开 AI 应用的用户。

**英文原文**

Apple's on-device AI layer, including the rebuilt Siri AI. Its AEO significance is distribution, since it reaches users who never open an AI app.

### 191. Brave Leo（Brave Leo）

Brave 内置的助手，由其独立搜索索引支持。Brave 是少数拥有自己索引而非授权索引的参与者，因此其答案可能明显不同。

**英文原文**

Brave's built-in assistant, backed by its independent search index. Brave is one of the few players with its own index rather than a licensed one, which is why its answers can differ noticeably.

### 192. Duck.ai（Duck.ai）

DuckDuckGo 注重隐私的聊天界面，与 Search Assist 摘要并行提供。份额很小，但适合用来检验你的可见度在四大平台之外是否仍成立。

**英文原文**

DuckDuckGo's privacy-focused chat interface, alongside its Search Assist summaries. Small share, and a useful check on whether your visibility holds up outside the big four.

### 193. Gemini Notebook（Gemini Notebook）

Google 的研究与文档工具，于 2026 年 7 月从 NotebookLM 更名而来。它依据用户指令获取来源，因此有自己的爬虫标识。

**英文原文**

Google's research and document tool, renamed from NotebookLM in July 2026. It fetches sources on the user's instruction, which is why it has its own crawler token.

### 194. AI 浏览器（AI browser）

在浏览体验本身内置助手或智能体的浏览器。这个类别变化极快，一年内就有多款产品上线与关闭，因此应围绕协议构建，而不是围绕某个产品。

**英文原文**

A browser with an assistant or agent built into the browsing experience itself. The category is churning fast, with several launches and shutdowns inside a single year, so build for the protocol rather than the product.

### 195. 答案引擎市场份额（Answer Engine market share）

AI 搜索使用量在各平台之间的分布。要留意分母：Similarweb 的网页流量份额，与 SparkToro 基于点击流计算的全部搜索份额，呈现的是很不一样的图景。后者认为，2025 年末 AI 工具约占美国桌面搜索活动的 3.2%。Profound 的免费 Profound Index 每周追踪各引擎上的品牌可见度。

**英文原文**

The distribution of AI Search usage across platforms. Be careful which denominator is being used, since [Similarweb's web-traffic share](<https://www.similarweb.com/blog/insights/ai-news/ai-referral-traffic-winners/>) and SparkToro's clickstream share of all searches produce very different pictures, the latter putting AI tools at roughly 3.2% of US desktop search activity in late 2025. Profound's free [Profound Index](<https://www.tryprofound.com/profound-index>) tracks brand visibility across engines weekly.


## 8. AI 爬虫与机器人／AI crawlers and bots

### 196. 用户代理标识（User agent）（User agent）

机器人每次请求时发送的身份识别字符串。你通过它在 robots.txt 中允许某种用途、拒绝另一种用途；所有这些控制实际都在这一层面进行。

**英文原文**

The identifying string a bot sends with each request. It's how you allow one purpose and deny another in robots.txt, and it's the level at which all of this is actually controlled.

### 197. 爬虫用途分类（Crawler purpose category）

依据机器人做什么、而非谁运营它来分类。Cloudflare 按行为把已验证机器人分为 11 类，并指出一个机器人可能同时属于多类；其中 Search、Agent、Training 被提供为可直接操作的预设。

**英文原文**

The classification of a bot by what it does rather than by who runs it. [Cloudflare](<https://developers.cloudflare.com/bots/concepts/bot/>) classifies verified bots by behavior across eleven values and notes that one bot can carry more than one, with Search, Agent and Training exposed as the presets you can actually act on.

### 198. 混合用途爬虫（Mixed-use crawler）

同时服务多个目的的机器人，例如既为搜索建立索引，又收集训练数据。正是这类机器人，使“把 AI 机器人全部屏蔽”成为糟糕建议。

**英文原文**

A bot that serves more than one purpose, such as indexing for search while also collecting training data. Mixed-use bots are the reason "just block the AI bots" is bad advice.

### 199. GPTBot（GPTBot）

OpenAI 的训练爬虫。屏蔽它会限制训练用途，但不会让你从 ChatGPT 的答案中消失。

**英文原文**

[OpenAI's](<https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/bots>) training crawler. Blocking it limits training use and doesn't remove you from ChatGPT's answers.

### 200. OAI-SearchBot（OAI-SearchBot）

OpenAI 用于建立 ChatGPT 答案背后搜索索引的爬虫。如果希望被引用，就应允许它。OpenAI 表示，选择退出的网站不会出现在 ChatGPT 搜索答案中，但仍可能作为导航链接出现。

**英文原文**

OpenAI's crawler for building the search index behind ChatGPT's answers. This is the one to allow if you want to be cited, and OpenAI says opted-out sites won't appear in ChatGPT search answers though they can still show up as navigational links.

### 201. ChatGPT-User（ChatGPT-User）

当用户或 GPT Action 请求特定页面时，OpenAI 使用的获取器。OpenAI 文档说明，robots.txt 规则可能不适用于它。

**英文原文**

OpenAI's fetcher for when a user or a GPT Action asks for a specific page. OpenAI documents that robots.txt rules may not apply to it.

### 202. OAI-AdsBot（OAI-AdsBot）

OpenAI 用于验证广告落地页的爬虫。它只访问已提交的广告目标页面，不用于训练。

**英文原文**

OpenAI's crawler for validating advertiser landing pages. It only visits submitted ad destinations and isn't used for training.

### 203. ClaudeBot（ClaudeBot）

Anthropic 的训练爬虫，遵守 robots.txt，并支持 crawl-delay。它的用途直接明确，是主要训练机器人中歧义最小的一个。

**英文原文**

[Anthropic's](<https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8896518-does-anthropic-crawl-data-from-the-web-and-how-can-site-owners-block-the-crawler>) training crawler, which honors robots.txt and supports crawl-delay. Straightforward, and the least ambiguous of the major training bots.

### 204. Claude-SearchBot（Claude-SearchBot）

Anthropic 用于建立 Claude 网页搜索索引的爬虫。如果希望 Claude 能引用你，就应允许它。

**英文原文**

Anthropic's crawler for building the index behind Claude's web search. Allow it if you want Claude to be able to cite you.

### 205. Claude-User（Claude-User）

Anthropic 用于用户发起检索的获取器。OpenAI、Google、Perplexity、Amazon 和 Meta 都在文档中说明，用户触发获取器有 robots.txt 豁免；Anthropic 没有为它声明任何豁免，反而警告屏蔽它可能降低你在 Claude 中的可见度。

**英文原文**

Anthropic's fetcher for user-initiated retrieval. OpenAI, Google, Perplexity, Amazon and Meta all document robots.txt exemptions for their user-triggered fetchers, and Anthropic documents none for this one, warning instead that blocking it may reduce your visibility in Claude.

### 206. PerplexityBot（PerplexityBot）

Perplexity 用于搜索和引用的爬虫，明确不用于基础模型训练。允许它是出现在 Perplexity 来源中的前提。

**英文原文**

[Perplexity's](<https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/perplexity-crawlers>) crawler for search and citation, explicitly not used for foundation-model training. Allowing it is a prerequisite for appearing in Perplexity's sources.

### 207. Perplexity-User（Perplexity-User）

Perplexity 的用户触发获取器，文档称其通常忽略 robots.txt。它很好地说明，robots.txt 是请求，而不是一道墙。

**英文原文**

Perplexity's user-triggered fetcher, which its documentation states generally ignores robots.txt. A good illustration of why robots.txt is a request and not a wall.

### 208. Googlebot（Googlebot）

Google 的主要搜索爬虫，也决定页面是否有资格进入 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode。屏蔽 Googlebot 会让你从整个 Google 中退出，因此它绝不是处理仅针对 AI 的决策的合适工具。

**英文原文**

[Google's](<https://developers.google.com/crawling/docs/crawlers-fetchers/overview-google-crawlers>) main search crawler, which also determines eligibility for AI Overviews and AI Mode. Blocking Googlebot removes you from Google entirely, so it's never the right tool for an AI-specific decision.

### 209. Google-Extended（Google-Extended）

robots.txt 控制标识，可让内容退出 Gemini 应用和 Vertex AI Gemini API 的训练与依据锚定用途。与大量已发表建议相反，它不控制 AI Overviews 或 AI Mode，也不是拥有独立 user-agent 字符串的爬虫。Google 在 AI 功能页面上说明了真正适用的控制方式。

**英文原文**

A robots.txt control token that opts your content out of training and grounding for the Gemini apps and the Vertex AI Gemini API. It does *not* control AI Overviews or AI Mode, contrary to a great deal of published advice, and it's not a crawler with its own user-agent string. Google documents the actual controls on its [AI features page](<https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features>).

### 210. GoogleOther（GoogleOther）

Google 用于研究和内部项目的通用爬虫。影响较小；这里列出它，是因为它会出现在日志中并让人困惑。

**英文原文**

Google's general-purpose crawler for research and internal projects. Low-stakes, and included here because it turns up in logs and confuses people.

### 211. Google-GeminiNotebook（Google-GeminiNotebook）

Google 用于获取用户添加到 Gemini Notebook 中的来源的获取器，于 2026 年 7 月从 Google-NotebookLM 更名。旧标识只被沿用到 2026 年 8 月，因此此前建立的日志解析规则需要更新。

**英文原文**

Google's fetcher for sources a user adds to Gemini Notebook, renamed from Google-NotebookLM in July 2026. The old token was honored only through August 2026, so log-parsing rules built before then need updating.

### 212. Google-Agent（Google-Agent）

Google 为其托管智能体提供的用户触发获取器，于 2026 年 3 月加入。与 Google 其他用户触发获取器一样，它通常忽略 robots.txt；它标志着从“为索引爬取”转向“为任务获取”。

**英文原文**

Google's user-triggered fetcher for its hosted agents, added in March 2026. Like Google's other user-triggered fetchers it generally ignores robots.txt, and it marks the shift from crawling for indexes to fetching on behalf of a task.

### 213. Applebot（Applebot）

Apple 用于搜索及训练数据来源的爬虫。如果找不到针对自己的规则，它会遵循 Googlebot 规则，这让许多站长措手不及。

**英文原文**

[Apple's](<https://support.apple.com/en-us/119829>) crawler for search and as a training source. If it finds no rules for itself, it follows your Googlebot rules, which catches a lot of site owners out.

### 214. Applebot-Extended（Applebot-Extended）

Apple 用于退出 AI 训练的控制标识。与 Google-Extended 一样，它是指令，而非爬虫。此外，Apple 将结构化数据中的 isAccessibleForFree: false 信号视为限制 AI 答案使用的信号。

**英文原文**

Apple's control token for opting out of AI training. Like Google-Extended it's a directive rather than a crawler. Separately, Apple treats an isAccessibleForFree: false signal in your structured data as a limit on AI-answer use.

### 215. Amazonbot（Amazonbot）

Amazon 的爬虫，可能用于改进产品、训练 Amazon 的 AI 模型。它遵守 robots.txt，并尊重 noarchive 与 noindex。

**英文原文**

[Amazon's](<https://developer.amazon.com/amazonbot>) crawler, which may be used to improve products and train Amazon's AI models. It honors robots.txt and respects noarchive and noindex.

### 216. Amzn-SearchBot（Amzn-SearchBot）

Amazon 用于搜索和 Alexa 答案的检索爬虫，与训练用途分开。能否出现在 Amazon AI 购物答案中，主要取决于它。

**英文原文**

Amazon's retrieval crawler for search and Alexa answers, separate from training use. This is the one that matters for appearing in Amazon's AI shopping answers.

### 217. Amzn-User（Amzn-User）

Amazon 的用户触发获取器，文档说明它可能不会遵循所有 robots.txt 指令。它属于与 OpenAI、Anthropic 相同的三机器人分工模式。

**英文原文**

Amazon's user-triggered fetcher, documented as possibly not following all robots.txt directives. Part of the same three-bot pattern as OpenAI and Anthropic.

### 218. meta-externalagent（meta-externalagent）

Meta 用于训练和直接索引的爬虫。Meta 官方文档将它写为全小写；如果你进行模式匹配，这一点很重要。

**英文原文**

[Meta's](<https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/sharing/webmasters/web-crawlers>) crawler for training and direct indexing. Meta's own documentation writes it lowercase, which matters if you're pattern-matching.

### 219. meta-webindexer（meta-webindexer）

Meta 用于在 Meta AI 答案中引用来源的检索爬虫。如果希望在 Meta 应用内被引用，就应允许它。

**英文原文**

Meta's retrieval crawler for citation in Meta AI answers. Allow it if you want to be quotable inside Meta's apps.

### 220. meta-externalfetcher（meta-externalfetcher）

Meta 的用户触发及智能体获取器，文档说明它可能绕过 robots.txt。Meta 还明确点名不接受非正式的 noai 标签。

**英文原文**

Meta's user-triggered and agentic fetcher, which its docs state may bypass robots.txt. Meta explicitly rejects the informal noai tag by name.

### 221. CCBot（CCBot）

Common Crawl 的归档爬虫，负责建立供数十种第三方模型训练的开放数据集。屏蔽它影响的下游模型，远多于屏蔽某一家实验室的机器人。

**英文原文**

[Common Crawl's](<https://commoncrawl.org/ccbot>) archiver, which builds the open dataset that dozens of third-party models train on. Blocking it affects far more downstream models than blocking any single lab's bot.

### 222. AI2Bot（AI2Bot）

Allen Institute 用于开放语言模型研究的爬虫。它属于非营利用途、透明公开，通常不值得屏蔽。

**英文原文**

The [Allen Institute's](<https://allenai.org/crawler>) crawler for open language model research. Nonprofit, transparent, and rarely worth blocking.

### 223. MistralAI-User（MistralAI-User）

目前唯一能在文档中找到的 Mistral 爬虫标识，而且仅见于 Cloudflare 的第三方机器人参考资料。Mistral 没有发布自己的爬虫文档，因此博客里出现的 MistralAI-Index 或 MistralAI-Training 标识，都应视为未经确认。

**英文原文**

The only Mistral crawler token documented anywhere, and only via Cloudflare's third-party bot reference. Mistral publishes no crawler documentation of its own, so treat any MistralAI-Index or MistralAI-Training token you see in a blog post as unconfirmed.

### 224. 已退役的爬虫标识（Retired crawler tokens）

Anthropic 的 Claude-Web 和 anthropic-ai 已不再出现在官方文档中；ChatGPT-Agent 虽出现在许多博客中，却不在 OpenAI 的爬虫文档里。应依据运营方文档审计 robots.txt，而不是照抄别人的 robots.txt；我们的可抓取性审计正是为此而设。

**英文原文**

Anthropic's Claude-Web and anthropic-ai no longer appear in its documentation, and ChatGPT-Agent doesn't appear in OpenAI's crawler documentation despite showing up in many blog posts. Audit your robots.txt against operator documentation rather than against other people's robots.txt, which is what our [crawlability audit](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/agent-analytics/crawlability>) is for.

### 225. 签名智能体（Signed agents）

通过密码学方式验证机器人确实是它所声称的身份。这是必要的，因为 user-agent 字符串极易伪造，也是 Web Bot Auth 存在的原因。

**英文原文**

Cryptographically verifying that a bot is who it claims to be. Necessary because user-agent strings are trivially spoofable, and the reason Web Bot Auth exists.

### 226. Web Bot Auth（Web Bot Auth）

让机器人通过带签名的 HTTP 请求证明身份的新兴标准。它使付费或许可式抓取能够真正执行，而不只是一个愿望。

**英文原文**

An emerging standard for bots to prove their identity using signed HTTP requests. It's what makes paid or permissioned crawling enforceable rather than aspirational.

### 227. 机器人目录（Bot directory）

公开列出已知 AI 爬虫、运营方和用途的参考目录。很有用，但应与运营方自己的文档交叉核对，因为二手目录可能收录从未真实存在过的标识。

**英文原文**

A public reference listing known AI crawlers, their operators and their purposes. Useful, and worth cross-checking against the operator's own docs, since secondary directories carry tokens that were never real.
