## 9. 访问控制、许可与变现／Access control, licensing and monetization

### 228. robots.txt（robots.txt）

网站根目录中的纯文本文件，用于告诉爬虫可以获取什么。它是由 RFC 9309 正式规定的自愿性约定，因此只是请求，而非强制执行机制。Profound 的技术 AEO 指南介绍了如何专门针对 AI 爬虫配置它。

**英文原文**

The plain text file at your site root that tells crawlers what they may fetch. It's a voluntary convention formalized as [RFC 9309](<https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9309.html>), which means it's a request rather than an enforcement mechanism. Profound’s [technical AEO guide](<https://www.tryprofound.com/articles/technical-aeo>) covers how to configure it for AI crawlers specifically.

### 229. 抓取延迟（Crawl-delay）（Crawl-delay）

请求机器人放慢速度的 robots.txt 指令。有些 AI 爬虫遵守，有些忽略，包括 Google 的爬虫。

**英文原文**

A robots.txt directive asking a bot to slow down. Honored by some AI crawlers and ignored by others, including Google's.

### 230. noindex（noindex）

让页面完全退出搜索索引的指令。对于 Google，它也会使页面失去进入 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 的资格。

**英文原文**

A directive keeping a page out of a search index entirely. For Google, this is also what removes a page from AI Overviews and AI Mode eligibility.

### 231. nosnippet（nosnippet）

禁止显示页面任何文本摘录的指令。它与 max-snippet 才是真正限制 Google AI 功能的控制手段，而不是 Google-Extended。

**英文原文**

A directive preventing any text excerpt from your page being shown. Along with max-snippet, this is the actual lever for limiting Google's AI features, not Google-Extended.

### 232. max-snippet（max-snippet）

限制页面可被引用字符数的指令。它提供的是可调节的旋钮，而非简单开关，通常在商业上更合理。

**英文原文**

A directive capping how many characters of your page can be quoted. It gives you a dial rather than a switch, which is usually the more commercially sensible choice.

### 233. noarchive（noarchive）

反对存储页面缓存副本的指令。值得注意的是，Microsoft 和 Amazon 将其解释为“不允许 AI 训练”，Google 则完全忽略它，这很好地说明了该领域尚未形成稳定规则。

**英文原文**

A directive against storing a cached copy. Worth knowing that it's interpreted as "no AI training" by Microsoft and Amazon and ignored entirely by Google, which is a good example of how unsettled this area is.

### 234. noai（noai）

宣称不允许 AI 使用的非正式 meta 标签。它没有标准支持，Meta 在文档中明确点名拒绝它，把它当成保护措施是错误的。

**英文原文**

An informal meta tag asserting no AI use. It has no standards backing, Meta rejects it by name in its documentation, and treating it as protection is a mistake.

### 235. llms.txt（llms.txt）

一项提议中的 Markdown 文件方案，目前为 v2，放在网站根目录，指引 AI 系统找到最能代表你的页面。AI 公司是否采用它，基本仍未获证实：Google 已表示 Google Search 不使用它，也没有主要运营方在文档中说明使用它。因此，应把它视为低成本保险，而非增长策略。我们的 llms.txt 说明文章介绍了具体格式。

**英文原文**

A [proposed markdown file](<https://llmstxt.org/>), now at v2, at your site root that points AI systems to the pages best representing you. Adoption by AI companies remains essentially unconfirmed: [Google has stated Google Search does not use it](<https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide>) and no major operator has documented using it, so treat it as low-cost insurance rather than a tactic. Our [llms.txt explainer](<https://www.tryprofound.com/articles/what-is-llms-txt-guide>) walks through the format.

### 236. llms-full.txt（llms-full.txt）

用纯文本包含完整文档的配套文件。它是由开发者文档平台推广的约定，而非原始规范的一部分。

**英文原文**

A companion file containing your full documentation as plain text. It's a convention popularized by developer-documentation platforms rather than part of the original specification.

### 237. 内容信号（Content Signals）（Content Signals）

一项提议中的 HTTP 标头与 robots.txt 扩展，让你分别表达允许搜索、训练、AI 输入等用途。Cloudflare 于 2025 年 9 月以 CC0 约定发布，并于 2026 年 7 月扩展；截至 2026 年 8 月，IETF 的 AIPREF 工作组中并行的标准化工作仍在进行。

**英文原文**

A [proposed HTTP header and robots.txt extension](<https://blog.cloudflare.com/content-signals-policy/>) letting you express permitted uses such as search, training or AI input separately. Cloudflare published it as a CC0 convention in September 2025 and extended it in July 2026, and the parallel standards work at the IETF's AIPREF working group remains active as of August 2026.

### 238. AI 使用偏好（AI preferences）

IETF 正在开展的标准化工作，旨在让出版商用机器可读方式声明内容可以如何被 AI 使用。它最可能成为最终正式标准的来源，但尚未完成。

**英文原文**

Ongoing standards work at the IETF to give publishers a machine-readable way to state how their content may be used by AI. It's the most likely source of an eventual real standard, and it's not finished.

### 239. Cloudflare AI Crawl Control（Cloudflare AI Crawl Control）

Cloudflare 用于允许、屏蔽或向单个 AI 爬虫收费的工具，前称 AI Audit。2026 年 7 月宣布、2026 年 9 月 15 日生效的新规则规定，新接入域名的带广告页面默认屏蔽训练和智能体爬虫，同时继续允许搜索爬虫。该设置实际位于 Cloudflare 的 AI bot policies，而非 Crawl Control 中。

**英文原文**

[Cloudflare's tooling](<https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-crawl-control/>) for allowing, blocking or charging individual AI crawlers, formerly called AI Audit. Announced in July 2026 and effective 15 September 2026, newly onboarding domains get training and agent crawlers blocked by default on ad-bearing pages while search crawlers stay allowed. The setting itself lives in Cloudflare's AI bot policies rather than in Crawl Control.

### 240. 按次抓取付费（Pay-per-crawl）

AI 公司每获取一个页面就付费，通常通过返回 HTTP 402 响应执行。目前可用范围仍有限，但作为首个可信的爬虫访问定价机制，具有重要意义。

**英文原文**

Charging AI companies for each page they fetch, typically enforced by returning an HTTP 402 response. Still limited in availability, and significant as the first credible mechanism for pricing crawler access.

### 241. 按次推理付费（Pay-per-inference）

另一种提议：内容被用于答案时，而不是被抓取时，向出版商付费。它与实际价值更一致，但也更难验证。

**英文原文**

The proposed alternative of paying publishers when their content is used in an answer rather than when it's fetched. Better aligned with value and much harder to verify.

### 242. HTTP 402（HTTP 402）

长期闲置的“Payment Required（需要付款）”状态码，如今被重新用于付费抓取和智能体支付的交互确认。它突然变得重要，恰好说明这一领域变化有多快。

**英文原文**

The long-dormant "Payment Required" status code, now being revived as the handshake for paid crawling and agent payments. Its sudden relevance is a decent shorthand for how fast this space is moving.

### 243. 简易许可（RSL）（RSL (Really Simple Licensing)）

供出版商为内容附加机器可读许可条款的标准。它希望让“你可以使用这些内容，条件如下，价格如下”能够通过文件表达，而不只写在合同里。

**英文原文**

A standard for publishers to attach machine-readable licensing terms to their content. It aims to make "you may use this, on these terms, for this price" expressible in a file rather than a contract.

### 244. 内容许可交易（Content licensing deal）

AI 公司与出版商就内容访问达成的直接商业协议。Reddit 的 SEC 文件披露，2024 年 1 月签订的数据许可安排总合同价值为 2.03 亿美元。在一个充斥泄露数字的领域，这是真正有可靠文档支持的数字。

**英文原文**

A direct commercial agreement between an AI company and a publisher for content access. [Reddit's SEC filings](<https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1713445/000162828024006294/0001628280-24-006294-index.html>) disclosed an aggregate contract value of $203 million for data-licensing arrangements signed in January 2024, which is the only reliably documented figure in a space full of leaked numbers.

### 245. TollBit（TollBit）

计量 AI 爬虫访问并将其商业化的第三方市场。它发布的机器人与人类流量比例研究，是抓取经济中较有用的公开数据之一。

**英文原文**

A third-party marketplace for metering and monetizing AI crawler access. Its published research on bot-to-human traffic ratios is among the more useful public data on the crawl economy.

### 246. 生成式功能退出控制（Generative features opt-out）

Google Search Console 中用于让网站退出某些 AI 体验的控制项。应仔细阅读适用范围，因为它并不覆盖人们以为的所有情况。

**英文原文**

Google Search Console's control for excluding your site from certain AI experiences. Read the scope carefully, because it doesn't cover everything people assume it does.


## 10. 智能体网络与 AI 商务／The agentic web and AI commerce

### 247. AI 智能体（AI agent）

不仅回答问题，还会采取行动、在有限监督下处理多步骤任务的 AI 系统。当买家是智能体时，无论你是否这样设计，你的网站都成了一个 API。

**英文原文**

An AI system that takes action rather than only answering, handling multi-step tasks with limited supervision. When your buyer is an agent, your site is an API whether you designed it that way or not.

### 248. 智能体浏览（Agentic browsing）

智能体代表用户导航网站并与之互动。它打破转化率优化背后的所有假设，因为已没有人类需要被说服。

**英文原文**

An agent navigating and interacting with websites on a user's behalf. It breaks every assumption behind conversion-rate optimization, because there's no human to persuade.

### 249. 模型上下文协议（MCP）（MCP (Model Context Protocol)）

由 Anthropic 发起的开放标准，用于连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据来源。它已成为助手访问实时系统的默认方式，因此 MCP 服务器也成为产品一种正当的分发渠道。

**英文原文**

An [open standard](<https://modelcontextprotocol.io/>), originated by Anthropic, for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. It has become the default way assistants reach live systems, which makes an MCP server a legitimate distribution channel for your product.

### 250. MCP 服务器（MCP server）

向任何支持该协议的 AI 客户端暴露工具或数据的服务。发布这样的服务，正越来越成为品牌在助手内部真正可用、而非只是被提到的方式。

**英文原文**

A service exposing your tools or data to any AI client that speaks the protocol. Publishing one is increasingly how a brand becomes usable inside an assistant rather than merely mentioned by it.

### 251. WebMCP（WebMCP）

一份社区小组草案，明确既不是 W3C 标准，也不在标准制定轨道上；它让网站通过浏览器直接向智能体暴露自身能力。它以“让网站可被智能体调用”来替代智能体不得不抓取页面的做法。

**英文原文**

A [Community Group draft](<https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/>), explicitly not a W3C standard nor on the standards track, for letting websites expose their own capabilities to agents directly through the browser. It's the "make your site agent-callable" answer to agents having to scrape you instead.

### 252. NLWeb（NLWeb）

将现有网站转变成可对话、可被智能体查询的端点的项目，起源于 Microsoft，目前独立开发。仍处早期，明确针对与 WebMCP 相同的问题。

**英文原文**

A [project](<https://github.com/nlweb-ai/NLWeb>) for turning existing websites into conversational, agent-queryable endpoints, originated at Microsoft and now developed independently. Early, and aimed squarely at the same problem as WebMCP.

### 253. 智能体商务协议（ACP）（Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)）

OpenAI 与 Stripe 制定的标准，让 AI 智能体能向商家完成购买，也是 ChatGPT Instant Checkout 背后的协议。2026 年 4 月版本将规范扩展至购物车、商品数据流和订单。

**英文原文**

An [OpenAI and Stripe standard](<https://www.agenticcommerce.dev/>) for AI agents to complete purchases with merchants, and the protocol behind ChatGPT's Instant Checkout. Its April 2026 release expanded the spec to cover carts, product feeds and orders.

### 254. 智能体支付协议（AP2）（AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol)）

Google 用于通过签名授权书批准智能体发起支付的标准，于 2026 年 4 月贡献给 FIDO Alliance。其结账授权书和支付授权书，使智能体能够证明自己确实获准花你的钱。

**英文原文**

[Google's standard](<https://ap2-protocol.org/>) for authorizing agent-initiated payments using signed mandates, contributed to the FIDO Alliance in April 2026. Its Checkout and Payment Mandates are how an agent proves it was actually authorized to spend your money.

### 255. 通用商务协议（UCP）（UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol)）

另一项相互竞争的智能体商务行业标准，明确设计为与 AP2 兼容。OpenAI 不在其由 16 名成员组成的 Shopping Tech Council 中，这表明协议之争尚未结束。

**英文原文**

A competing industry standard for agentic commerce, explicitly designed to be compatible with AP2. OpenAI is absent from its 16-member Shopping Tech Council, which tells you the protocol war isn't over.

### 256. 智能体间协议（A2A）（A2A (Agent2Agent)）

让智能体彼此通信、委派工作的标准，Google 于 2025 年 6 月将其捐赠给 Linux Foundation。当购买涉及一个智能体与你的智能体交谈，而不是与你的网站交互时，它就很重要。

**英文原文**

A [standard for agents](<https://a2a-protocol.org/>) to communicate and delegate to one another, donated by Google to the Linux Foundation in June 2025. It matters once buying involves an agent talking to your agent rather than to your site.

### 257. Perplexity 即时结账（Perplexity instant checkout）

Perplexity 在答案内完成购买的功能，由 Buy with Pro 演变而来，2025 年 11 月与 PayPal 合作重新推出，目前向美国用户免费开放。它较早证明了答案本身可以成为结账页面。

**英文原文**

Perplexity's in-answer purchase feature, descended from Buy with Pro and relaunched with PayPal in November 2025, now free to US users. An early proof that the answer itself can be the checkout page.

### 258. 帮我购买（Buy for Me）（Buy for Me）

Amazon 用于从 Amazon 之外的商家完成购买的功能。它把 Amazon 的智能体放到了你与自己的店面之间。

**英文原文**

Amazon's feature for completing purchases from merchants outside Amazon. It puts Amazon's agent between you and your own storefront.

### 259. 智能体就绪度（Agent readiness）

访客是软件时，网站运行得有多好：标记清晰、选择器稳定、标签可访问，关键内容不被互动操作锁住。它大体上是对本来就应该做的无障碍工作的重新发现。

**英文原文**

How well your site works when the visitor is software: clean markup, stable selectors, accessible labels and no critical content locked behind interaction. It's mostly a rediscovery of accessibility work you were already supposed to do.

### 260. 智能体可读性（Agentic readability）

智能体能否可靠提取含义，并在页面上行动。实用测试很简单：关闭 JavaScript，阅读页面，看看重要事实是否还在。

**英文原文**

Whether an agent can reliably extract meaning and act on your pages. The practical test is simple: turn off JavaScript, read the page, and see whether the important facts survive.

### 261. 技能（Skills）（Skills）

教会助手如何做好特定任务的一组打包指令。品牌自己编写的技能，正成为控制助手如何呈现产品的新方式。

**英文原文**

Packaged instructions that teach an assistant how to perform a specific task well. Brand-authored skills are an emerging way to control how an assistant represents your product.

### 262. 副驾驶（智能体语境）（Copilot (agent sense)）

负责起草或推荐，并在每一步实际发生前等待人类批准的 AI 系统。它介于只回答问题的助手与自主行动的 AI 智能体之间，不等同于 Microsoft Copilot。

**英文原文**

An AI system that drafts or recommends and waits for a person to approve each step before anything happens. It sits between an assistant that only answers and an AI agent that acts on its own. Not the same as Microsoft Copilot.

### 263. 营销工程师（Marketing Engineer）

结合创造力与系统思维、直觉与技术能力，构建自动化流程的营销人员。他们运用营销经验和工程思维，发现团队其他人看不到的机会，再建立系统抓住机会，获得只有智能体才能带来的速度与规模。

**英文原文**

A Marketing Engineer is a marketer who builds automations by combining creativity with systems thinking and instincts with technical ability. They use marketing experience and an engineering mindset to spot opportunities that the rest of the team can't see. Then build systems that capture them, with the speed and scale that only agents can deliver

### 264. 智能体营销（Agentic marketing）

把重复性工作交给既能决策又能执行的软件。它与自动化的区别在于：软件自行选择步骤，而不需要你逐步指挥。

**英文原文**

The practice of handing repeatable work to software that can decide as well as execute. What separates it from automation is that the software chooses its own steps rather than needing you to direct each one.

### 265. 自动化（Automation）

按照预先写好的规则工作、但从不自行决策的软件。它会一直执行相同逻辑，即使逻辑早已失效也不停；这正是它与 AI 智能体的区别。

**英文原文**

Software that follows rules you write in advance but never decides anything. It runs the same logic forever, right past the point where the logic stops working, which is what separates it from an AI agent.

### 266. 确定性步骤（Discrete step）

只有一个正确答案、每次都得到相同结果的行动。把流程区分为确定性步骤和判断性工作，就能决定哪些工作可以交出去，哪些应留在自己手里。

**英文原文**

An action with one right answer that gets the same result every time. Sorting your steps into discrete steps and judgment work decides which half of the job you can hand over and which half you should keep.

### 267. 判断性工作（Judgment work）

依赖人类作出决策的工作。它依赖指令中没有写出的因素，运用模式识别、业务背景和经验。一个明显标志是：两位都懂这份工作的人，可能对某一步产生分歧。

**英文原文**

Work that depends on a human to make a decision. It depends on things not written in the instructions and runs on pattern recognition, business context and experience, and a good tell is a step where two people who both know the job could disagree.


## 11. AI 搜索内容策略／Content strategy for AI Search

### 268. 答案前置格式（Answer-first formatting）

把直接答案放在顶部，支撑细节放在后面。检索系统提取段落，模型又对前部文本赋予更高权重，因此把结论埋起来是完全可以避免的错误。参见 Profound 关于针对 AI 搜索优化内容的指南。

**英文原文**

Putting the direct answer at the top and the supporting detail below. Retrieval systems extract passages and models weight early text more heavily, so burying the conclusion is an unforced error. See Profound’s guide to [optimizing content for AI Search](<https://www.tryprofound.com/articles/optimize-content-for-ai-search>).

### 269. 倒金字塔结构（Inverted pyramid）

先给结论，再逐渐深入细节的新闻写作结构。它恰好也是检索系统偏好的格式，是优秀写作与优秀优化难得一致的例子。

**英文原文**

The journalistic structure of leading with the conclusion and descending into detail. It happens to be the format retrieval systems reward, which is a rare case of good writing and good optimization agreeing.

### 270. 原子化内容（Atomic content）

让每个章节都自包含、能够独立理解的写法。如果某一节必须读完上一节才有意义，它就可能被错误引用，或者根本不被引用。

**英文原文**

Writing each section so it's self-contained and independently meaningful. If a section only makes sense after reading the one above it, it'll be cited badly or not at all.

### 271. 分块优化（Chunk optimization）

通过组织标题、段落换行和列表，让检索系统提取出的片段，正好是你希望它选择的片段。这是内容团队影响检索最直接的手段。

**英文原文**

Structuring headings, paragraph breaks and lists so that the pieces a retrieval system extracts are the pieces you'd have chosen. It's the most direct lever content teams have on retrieval.

### 272. 信息增益（Information gain）

页面相对于已有内容新增的独特数据、原创研究或一手洞察。Google 持有一项 2022 年获批的衡量相关专利，但专利描述的是相对于会话、按用户计算的方法，而不是覆盖整个语料库的静态原创性分数。

**英文原文**

The unique data, original research or firsthand insight a page adds beyond what's already published. Google holds a [patent on measuring it](<https://patents.google.com/patent/US11354342B2/en>), granted in 2022, though the patent describes a session-relative and per-user calculation rather than a static corpus-wide originality score.

### 273. 原创研究（Original research）

发布别人没有的数据。这是成为“其他来源也会引用的来源”最可靠的方法，也是间接进入答案的途径。

**英文原文**

Publishing data nobody else has. It's the most reliable way to become a source that other sources cite, which is how you get pulled into answers indirectly.

### 274. 统计数据页面（Statistics page）

汇集某个主题下有来源数字的页面。它们获得的引用，往往远超投入所对应的水平，因为答案不断需要一个可指向的数字。

**英文原文**

A page collecting cited figures on a topic. These earn citations far out of proportion to their effort, because answers constantly need a number to point at.

### 275. 比较页面（Comparison page）

把你的产品与明确列出的替代方案进行比较的页面。比较型提示词是短名单形成的地方；Profound 与 Kevin Indig、Clickstream Solutions 的行为研究发现，在 35.9% 的购物任务中，比较表格保持注意力的时间最长，仅次于普通答案文字。

**英文原文**

A page weighing your product against named alternatives. Comparison prompts are where shortlists form, and Profound's [behavioral study with Kevin Indig and Clickstream Solutions](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/the-shortlist-is-the-new-shelf>) found comparison grids held attention longest in 35.9% of shopping tasks, second only to the plain answer text.

### 276. 替代方案页面（Alternatives page）

回答“X 的替代方案”查询的页面，X 可以是你，也可以是竞争对手。发布这种内容可能让人不舒服，但它持续有效，因为这正是买家问的问题。

**英文原文**

A page addressing "alternatives to X" queries, whether X is you or a competitor. Uncomfortable to publish and consistently effective, because it's exactly what the buyer asked.

### 277. 清单文章的作用（Listicle leverage）

让品牌进入 AI 答案依赖的第三方“最佳工具”榜单。它通常比让自己的页面在同一查询上取得排名更快。

**英文原文**

Getting your brand included in the third-party "best tools" lists that AI answers lean on. It's often faster than trying to rank your own page for the same query.

### 278. 内容新鲜度（Content freshness）

页面距发布或实质性更新过去多久。答案引擎偏好当前来源；陈旧页面会悄悄教给模型关于定价和产品的过时事实。

**英文原文**

How recently a page was published or meaningfully updated. Answer Engines favor current sources, and stale pages quietly teach models stale facts about your pricing and product.

### 279. 内容更新（Content refresh）

系统更新现有页面，而不只是发布新页面。在 AEO 中，它通常比全新内容回报更高，因为引用已经存在，只是事实不正确。

**英文原文**

Systematically updating existing pages rather than only publishing new ones. In AEO this is usually higher return than net-new content, because the citation is already there and only the facts are wrong.

### 280. 主题权威性（Topical authority）

对某个主题进行深入、相互链接的覆盖，使系统相信你是该主题的权威来源。只有广度没有深度，看起来像内容农场；只有深度没有广度，则像一篇偶然成功的帖子。

**英文原文**

Deep, interlinked coverage of a subject that convinces systems you're a definitive source on it. Breadth without depth reads as a content farm, and depth without breadth reads as a single lucky post.

### 281. 主题集群（Topic cluster）

围绕一个核心支柱页组织的一组相关页面。它仍是建立能被搜索引擎和检索系统识别的主题权威性的最清晰方法。

**英文原文**

A group of related pages organized around a central pillar page. It remains the cleanest way to build topical authority that both search engines and retrieval systems can see.

### 282. 支柱页面（Pillar page）

主题集群中其他页面链接回来的综合枢纽页。当问题宽泛时，你希望它被检索；当问题具体时，则希望具体页面被检索。

**英文原文**

The comprehensive hub page a topic cluster links back to. It's the page you want retrieved when the question is broad and the specifics when it's narrow.

### 283. 机器可读内容（Machine-readable content）

结构清楚、让软件不必猜测就能解析含义的内容。使用清晰标题、真实 HTML、纯文本和结构化数据，而不是把文字嵌进图片，或靠脚本临时组装。

**英文原文**

Content structured so software can parse its meaning without guessing. Clear headings, real HTML, plain text and structured data, rather than text baked into images or assembled by scripts.

### 284. AI 可抓取性（Crawlability for AI）

AI 机器人能否真正访问并解析页面。许多 AI 爬虫不执行 JavaScript，因此只有脚本运行后才出现的内容，无论多好，都可能对它们不可见。Profound 的可抓取性审计正是测试这一点。

**英文原文**

Whether AI bots can actually reach and parse your pages. Many AI crawlers don't execute JavaScript, so content that only appears after scripts run may be invisible to them regardless of how good it is. Profound's [crawlability audit](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/agent-analytics/crawlability>) tests for exactly this.

### 285. 服务端渲染（Server-side rendering）

由服务器发送已经完整形成的 HTML，而不是在浏览器中组装。它是改善 AI 可抓取性最可靠的单项技术修复。

**英文原文**

Delivering fully-formed HTML from the server rather than assembling it in the browser. It's the single most reliable technical fix for AI crawlability.

### 286. 搜索差距（Search gap）

AI 引擎针对主题实际执行的问题，与已发布用于回答这些问题的内容之间的差距。弥合它，意味着不仅为人输入的查询写作，也为机器生成的查询写作。

**英文原文**

The distance between the questions AI engines actually run on a topic and the content you've published to answer them. Closing it means writing for the queries the machine generates, not only the ones people type.

### 287. 面向 AI 的数字公关（Digital PR for AI）

在 AI 答案已经引用的第三方网站上赢得报道。这是将传统公关的目标从受众转向引用网络。

**英文原文**

Earning coverage on the third-party sites that AI answers already cite. It's traditional PR retargeted at a citation graph instead of an audience.

### 288. 寄生 SEO（Parasite SEO）

在别人的高权威域名上发布内容，借用其地位。它有效但脆弱，并受 Google 网站声誉滥用政策约束。

**英文原文**

Publishing on someone else's high-authority domain to borrow its standing. It works, it's fragile, and Google's [site reputation abuse policy](<https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies#site-reputation-abuse>) covers it.

### 289. 借用权威（Borrowed authority）

让你的信息出现在模型已经信任的域名上。它是寄生 SEO 的正当版本，对自有域名还很年轻的品牌而言，也是合理策略。

**英文原文**

Getting your message onto a domain the model already trusts. The honest version of parasite SEO, and a reasonable strategy when your own domain is young.

### 290. 可摘取性（Extractability）

页面的一部分被单独取出、没有周围页面内容时，是否仍能被理解。它决定一个段落能否独立被引用。另见原子化内容和语义分块。

**英文原文**

Whether a piece of your page can be lifted out on its own and still make sense with none of the page around it. It decides whether a passage can be cited alone. See also Atomic content and Semantic chunking.

### 291. 可获取、被选中、可摘取（Fetchable, chosen, extractable）

页面在被 AI 引用前必须通过的三道关：可获取，指 AI 能访问并摄入页面；被选中，指 AI 判断页面可信到足以引用；可摘取，指 AI 能从中提取一项具体主张，并在答案中使用。

**英文原文**

The three gates a page has to pass before AI can cite it. Fetchable is whether AI can reach and ingest the page. Chosen is whether AI judges the page credible enough to cite. Extractable is whether AI can pull a specific claim out of it and use that claim in an answer.

### 292. 对外沟通参考卡（Battlecard）（Battlecard）

统一团队内部沟通、指导外联的单一参考文档。所有外联人员都使用同样的话术，这很重要，因为 AI 会根据阅读到的所有来源，形成关于你的统一描述。

**英文原文**

A single reference document that aligns your team's communication internally and guides your outreach. Everyone doing outreach works from the same lines, which matters because AI builds one description of you from every source it reads.

### 293. 指挥者模式（Conductor model）

SEO 团队协调 AEO、但不替所有人完成工作的方式：编写简报和交接文档，让其他团队更容易执行本就属于他们的目标。

**英文原文**

The way an SEO team coordinates AEO without doing everyone's work: it builds the briefs and handoff documents that make it easy for other teams to execute against goals that are already theirs.

### 294. 任务分流逻辑（Routing logic）

在任何人开始写作之前，对每个机会进行检查：比较品牌在发现型提示词和验证型提示词中的表现。发现低、验证也低，是应在站内修复的理解问题；发现低、验证良好，则是应通过站外工作修复的信任问题。

**英文原文**

The check you run on each opportunity before anyone starts writing, comparing how you show up on discovery prompts with how you show up on validation prompts. Low discovery with low validation is a comprehension problem fixed on-page, and low discovery with good validation is a trust problem fixed off-page.

### 295. 点击深度（Click depth）

从首页到达某页面所需的点击次数。页面之间如何链接，决定爬虫能到哪里，因此网站结构会影响 AI 能否找到回答问题的页面。

**英文原文**

The number of clicks it takes to get from your homepage to a page. The way your pages link to each other decides what a crawler reaches, so site structure affects whether AI can find the page that answers a question.

### 296. 孤立页面（Orphaned page）

网站中没有任何其他页面链接到的页面。爬虫沿链接前进，没有路径通向它，就会让 AI 难以到达这个能够回答问题的页面。

**英文原文**

A page that no other page on your site links to. A crawler follows links, so nothing leads it there, which makes it hard for AI to reach the page that answers a question.


## 12. 实体与结构化数据／Entities and structured data

### 297. 实体（Entity）

系统识别并追踪的独立事物，例如公司、产品或人物。把品牌建立为清晰定义的实体，是可见度与准确性的共同基础。

**英文原文**

A distinct thing a system recognizes and tracks, such as a company, product or person. Establishing your brand as a clearly defined entity is the foundation under both visibility and accuracy.

### 298. 实体建立（Entity establishment）

被识别为具体、无歧义的事物，而不是一串字符。实现它，需要一致的命名、一致的描述，以及多个独立来源的相互佐证。

**英文原文**

Getting recognized as a specific, unambiguous thing rather than a string of characters. Consistent naming, consistent descriptions and corroboration across independent sources are what do it.

### 299. 实体消歧（Entity disambiguation）

帮助系统把你与其他名称相似的事物区分开。工作很枯燥，但不做的结果，是与一家你从未听说过的公司混为一谈。

**英文原文**

Helping systems tell you apart from other things with similar names. The work is boring and the alternative is being merged with a company you've never heard of.

### 300. 实体混淆（Entity confusion）

系统把你的品牌与名称相近的公司、被收购的产品，或旧版本业务搞混。它是 AI 搜索中代价最高的失败模式，因为看起来像获得可见度，实际上却在伤害你。

**英文原文**

When a system mixes your brand up with a similarly named company, an acquired product or an old version of your business. It's the most expensive failure mode in AI Search because it damages you while looking like visibility.

### 301. 实体显著性（Entity salience）

在系统理解中，你的品牌对某个主题有多核心。它区分了“知道你存在”与“把你作为答案”。

**英文原文**

How central your brand is to a given topic in a system's understanding. It's what separates being known to exist from being the answer.

### 302. 知识图谱（Knowledge graph）

供搜索与 AI 系统查询的实体及其关系的结构化地图。机器借此知道 CEO 是一个人、产品是软件，而且两者相互关联。

**英文原文**

A structured map of entities and the relationships between them, consulted by search and AI systems. It's how a machine knows your CEO is a person, your product is software, and the two are related.

### 303. 知识面板（Knowledge panel）

搜索引擎为已识别实体展示的信息框。它是否出现，能较好表明实体是否已建立；其中的内容，则较好反映机器相信什么。

**英文原文**

The information box search engines show for a recognized entity. Its presence is a decent signal that your entity is established, and its contents are a decent signal of what the machine believes.

### 304. Wikidata（Wikidata）

Wikipedia 背后的开放结构化数据库，也是知识图谱的常见输入来源。比 Wikipedia 更容易进入，却经常被忽视。

**英文原文**

The open structured database behind Wikipedia and a common input to knowledge graphs. Easier to get into than Wikipedia and frequently overlooked.

### 305. Wikipedia 收录（Wikipedia presence）

Wikipedia 上有一篇关于公司的条目。其影响经常被夸大：2025 年 6 月的数据中，Wikipedia 约占 ChatGPT 前十大域名引用的 47.9%，但只占全部 ChatGPT 引用约 7.8%；Profound 后来的测量结果还更低。

**英文原文**

Having an article about your company on Wikipedia. Its influence is routinely overstated: on June 2025 data Wikipedia was about 47.9% of ChatGPT's *top-ten domains* but only around 7.8% of all ChatGPT citations, and [Profound's later measurement](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/where-do-ai-citations-come-from>) put it lower still.

### 306. 关注度资格（Notability）（Notability）

Wikipedia 判断一个主题是否值得建立条目的门槛，以独立报道为依据。不能花钱购买，也不能自己写自己的条目；尝试任一做法都会带来糟糕结果。

**英文原文**

Wikipedia's threshold for whether a subject warrants an article, judged by independent coverage. You can't buy it, you can't write your own article, and attempting either goes badly.

### 307. 结构化数据（Structured data）

页面代码中的机器可读标签，明确说明内容是什么。它消除了分析器的猜测空间，但它能否提高 AI 引用，现有证据并不一致。

**英文原文**

Machine-readable labels in your page code that state explicitly what the content is. It removes guesswork for parsers, and the evidence on whether it lifts AI citations is mixed.

### 308. Schema.org（Schema.org）

大多数结构化数据使用的共享词汇体系。其中 Organization、Product、Article、Person，对品牌理解最有分量。

**英文原文**

The [shared vocabulary](<https://schema.org/>) most structured data uses. Organization, Product, Article and Person are the types that carry the most weight for brand understanding.

### 309. JSON-LD（JSON-LD）

添加结构化数据的首选格式，以脚本块嵌入。Google 更推荐它，而非较旧的 Microdata 和 RDFa 格式。

**英文原文**

The [preferred format](<https://www.w3.org/TR/json-ld11/>) for adding structured data, embedded as a script block. Google recommends it over the older Microdata and RDFa formats.

### 310. sameAs（sameAs）

把实体链接到其他权威资料页的 schema 属性。它是成本最低、最直接的实体消歧信号。

**英文原文**

A schema property linking your entity to its other authoritative profiles. It's the cheapest, most direct entity disambiguation signal available.

### 311. Organization 结构化数据（Organization schema）

描述公司的结构化数据，包括名称、标志、简介和社交资料。如果仅出于 AEO 原因实现一种 schema 类型，就实现它。

**英文原文**

Structured data describing your company, including name, logo, description and social profiles. If you only implement one schema type for AEO reasons, implement this one.

### 312. Product 结构化数据（Product schema）

描述产品的结构化数据，包括价格、库存和评价。用具体、明确的属性填充，而非只满足最低要求，才有助于机器正确描述产品。

**英文原文**

Structured data describing a product, including price, availability and reviews. Populating it with concrete, specific attributes rather than the bare minimum is the part that helps a machine describe your product correctly.

### 313. FAQPage 结构化数据（FAQPage schema）

标记问答内容的结构化数据。注意，Google 的 FAQ 富结果已于 2026 年 5 月 7 日停止出现，报告支持也在随后几个月撤回。因此，应为机器可读性实现它，而不是为了已不存在的视觉展示。

**英文原文**

Structured data marking up question-and-answer content. Note that [Google's FAQ rich results](<https://developers.google.com/search/updates#faq-deprecation>) stopped appearing on 7 May 2026, with reporting support withdrawn over the following months, so implement it for machine readability rather than for a visual result that no longer exists.

### 314. 作者标记（Author markup）

识别页面作者并建立其资历的结构化数据。它支持 E-E-A-T 中的经验和专业性，而 AI 系统在选择来源时似乎会考虑这些因素。

**英文原文**

Structured data identifying who wrote a page and establishing their credentials. It supports the experience and expertise parts of E-E-A-T, which AI systems appear to weigh when choosing sources.

### 315. schema 的证据问题（The schema evidence problem）

关于结构化数据是否提高 AI 引用的对照测试，得出了相互矛盾的结果。其中，一项大型双重差分研究发现，它在 ChatGPT 和 AI Mode 中的效果与零无显著差别，在 AI Overviews 中略为负面。消融测试持续发现，只有渲染后的可见文本才能被可靠检索。因此，应把 schema 当成帮助机器澄清含义的工具，而非增长手段。

**英文原文**

Controlled testing on whether structured data lifts AI citations has produced conflicting results, including a large [diff-in-differences study](<https://ahrefs.com/blog/schema-ai-citations/>) finding effects indistinguishable from zero on ChatGPT and AI Mode and slightly negative in AI Overviews. Ablation testing has consistently found that only rendered, visible text was reliably retrieved, so treat schema as clarification for machines rather than a growth lever.


## 13. 流量、分析与归因／Traffic, analytics and attribution

### 316. AI 引荐流量（AI referral traffic）

从 AI 平台到达网站的访问。它在总流量中占比仍小，但增长很快。Profound 关于将 AI 引荐数据连接到 Google Analytics 的指南，说明了如何真正查看它。

**英文原文**

Visits arriving at your site from an AI platform. It's still a small share of total traffic and it's growing fast. Profound's guide to [connecting AI referral data to Google Analytics](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/google-analytics>) covers how to actually see it.

### 317. 来源字符串（Referrer string）

浏览器传递的、表示访客来自哪里的标识，例如 chatgpt.com 或 perplexity.ai。它是所有 AI 流量报告的原始材料，却经常缺失。

**英文原文**

The identifier a browser passes indicating where a visitor came from, such as chatgpt.com or perplexity.ai. It's the raw material of every AI traffic report and it's frequently missing.

### 318. utm_source=chatgpt.com（utm_source=chatgpt.com）

ChatGPT 添加到外链上的 UTM 参数。很方便，但各平台并不一致，也不能替代正确的渠道分组。

**英文原文**

The UTM parameter ChatGPT appends to outbound links. Convenient, inconsistent across platforms, and not a substitute for proper channel grouping.

### 319. GA4 AI Assistants 渠道（GA4 AI Assistants channel）

Google 于 2026 年 5 月在 GA4 中加入的默认渠道分组，由 medium 值“ai-assistant”触发。Google 文档列举 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、DeepSeek、Copilot、Grok，但尚未公布完整来源列表，因此自定义渠道分组仍值得保留。

**英文原文**

A [default channel group](<https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9756891?hl=en>) Google added to GA4 in May 2026, triggered by a medium of "ai-assistant." Google's documentation names ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Copilot and Grok as examples but hasn't published the full referrer list, so custom channel groups are still worth keeping.

### 320. 暗流量（Dark traffic）

没有可用来源信息、被计入直接访问的流量。原生桌面和移动助手应用是主要贡献者，因此真实的 AI 驱动流量高于仪表盘显示的数值。Profound 的 Agent Analytics 部分通过服务器日志来绕开这一问题。

**英文原文**

Visits with no usable referrer that land in direct traffic. Native desktop and mobile assistant apps are a major contributor, which means your real AI-driven traffic is higher than your dashboard shows. Profound's [Agent Analytics](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/agent-analytics>) works from server logs partly to get around this.

### 321. 归因缺口（Attribution gap）

AI 搜索实际产生的影响，与分析工具能够证明的影响之间的结构性差异。这也是 AEO 报告更依赖可见度和引用指标，而不是会话次数的原因。

**英文原文**

The structural difference between the influence AI Search has and the influence your analytics can prove. It's why AEO reporting leans on visibility and citation metrics rather than sessions.

### 322. 生成式 AI 效果报告（Generative AI performance report）

Google Search Console 于 2026 年 6 月推出、覆盖 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 的报告。它合并两个界面，只提供页面、国家、日期和设备维度，而且只报告展示量。来自 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 的点击被计入主效果报告的网页结果中，只是始终没有单独拆分。

**英文原文**

[Google Search Console's report](<https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/16984139?hl=en>) covering AI Overviews and AI Mode, launched in June 2026. It aggregates the two surfaces, offers only Pages, Countries, Dates and Devices as dimensions, and reports impressions only. Clicks from AI Overviews and AI Mode are counted inside the main Performance report's web results; they're simply never broken out.

### 323. 品牌搜索提升（Branded search lift）

直接搜索品牌名称的人数增加。当答案提到你却不附链接时，效果往往体现在品牌搜索中；不过 Profound 也追踪到，ChatGPT 含链接回答的比例正在显著提高。

**英文原文**

An increase in people searching your brand name directly. When an answer names you without linking you, branded search is often where the effect actually shows up, though Profound has tracked [ChatGPT sharply increasing the share of responses containing a link](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/chatgpt-referrals-branded-links>).

### 324. 零点击率（Zero-click rate）

没有点击任何网站就结束的搜索占比。Profound 针对 AI 助手的任务级研究发现，92.8% 的购物任务结束时完全没有有实质意义的点击。

**英文原文**

The share of searches ending without a click to any site. Profound's task-level study of AI assistants found [92.8% of shopping tasks ended with no meaningful click at all](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/the-shortlist-is-the-new-shelf>).

### 325. AI 流量转化率（Conversion rate of AI traffic）

AI 引荐访客相对其他渠道的转化表现。局面已经逆转：Adobe 测得，2024 年 7 月 AI 引荐零售流量的转化比非 AI 流量低 43%，到 2025 年 2 月缩小为低 9%；2026 年 3 月反转为高 42%，到 2026 年 5 月则高 54%。

**英文原文**

How AI-referred visitors convert relative to other channels. The picture has reversed: [Adobe](<https://business.adobe.com/blog/ai-driven-traffic-surges-across-industries>) measured AI-referred retail traffic converting 43% worse than non-AI traffic in July 2024, narrowing to 9% worse by February 2025, then flipping to 42% better in March 2026 and 54% better by May 2026.

### 326. 机器人与人类访问比（Bot-to-human ratio）

网站每获得一次人类访问，会收到多少次 AI 爬虫访问。TollBit 在自身网络内的出版商中测得，2025 年这一比例从约 1:200 变为 1:31；Profound 的 Agent Analytics 会为你自己的域名衡量同一比例。

**英文原文**

How many AI crawler visits your site receives per human visitor. [TollBit](<https://tollbit.com/state-of-the-bots/q2-2025/>) measured bot visits per human visit across publishers on its own network moving from roughly 1:200 to 1:31 over 2025, and Profound's [Agent Analytics](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/agent-analytics>) measures the same ratio for your own domain.

### 327. 仅展示量报告（Impression-only reporting）

只告诉你页面被展示、却不告诉你是否有人采取行动的指标。这是各 AI 界面中占主导的报告模式，如今适应它也是工作的一部分。

**英文原文**

Metrics that tell you a page was shown but not whether anyone acted on it. It's the dominant reporting mode across AI surfaces, and getting comfortable with it is part of the job now.

### 328. 自报式归因（SRA）（Self-reported attribution (SRA)）

直接询问客户如何找到你。它能显示点击数据遗漏的 AI 影响，因为其中很多影响从来不会以引荐访问的形式出现。

**英文原文**

Asking customers directly how they found you. It shows AI influence that click data misses, because much of it never arrives as a referral.


## 14. 沿用的 SEO 概念／SEO carryover

### 329. 搜索引擎优化（SEO）（SEO (Search Engine Optimization)）

在传统搜索结果中争取可见度的实践。它并未过时，因为自然搜索排名仍是预测 AI 答案引用的最强单一因素。

**英文原文**

The practice of earning visibility in traditional search results. It's not obsolete, since organic rank remains the strongest single predictor of getting cited in AI answers.

### 330. 排名与引用的关系（The rank-citation relationship）

持续被观察到的现象：传统搜索排名好的页面，更可能被 AI 答案引用。Ahrefs 在 2025 年 7 月发现，76.10% 的 AI Overview 引用来自前十名结果；2026 年 3 月重做研究得到 37.9%，它将下降归因于 Gemini 3 时代的查询扇出，以及自身解析方式的改进。应把两者理解为前后对比，而不是互相冲突的数字；同时注意，Ahrefs 另行将排名与引用的关系描述为正相关，但强度仅属中等。

**英文原文**

The consistent finding that pages ranking well in traditional search are far more likely to be cited in AI answers. Ahrefs [found 76.10% of AI Overview citations came from top-ten results](<https://ahrefs.com/blog/search-rankings-ai-citations/>) in July 2025, then [reran the study in March 2026 and got 37.9%](<https://ahrefs.com/blog/ai-overview-citations-top-10/>), a drop it attributes to Gemini 3-era query fan-out alongside its own improved parsing. Read them as before-and-after rather than as competing figures, and note Ahrefs separately characterizes the rank-to-citation relationship as [positive but only moderate](<https://ahrefs.com/blog/does-ranking-higher-on-google-mean-youll-get-cited-in-ai-overviews/>).

### 331. E-E-A-T（E-E-A-T）

Experience（经验）、Expertise（专业性）、Authoritativeness（权威性）、Trustworthiness（可信度），也写作 EEAT，是 Google 人类搜索质量评估员用来评估网页内容质量与可信度的框架。Google 表示它不是一个具体排名因素，同时又有意提高与之相符信号的权重，尤其是健康和金融主题。它很适合作为检查内容是否值得引用的清单。

**英文原文**

Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness and Trustworthiness (also written EEAT), the framework Google's human search quality raters use to evaluate the quality and credibility of web content. [Google says](<https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content>) it's not a specific ranking factor while also deliberately weighting signals aligned with it, more so on health and finance topics, and it works well as a checklist for whether content deserves to be cited.

### 332. 精选摘要（Featured snippet）

传统搜索结果中提取出的答案框。它曾是答案前置写法的训练场，这些技能可以直接迁移。

**英文原文**

The extracted answer box in traditional results. It was the training ground for answer-first writing, and the skills transfer directly.

### 333. 反向链接（Backlinks）

其他网站指向你的网站的链接。它们对 AEO 的作用是间接的：推动能预测引用的自然搜索排名，而不是被模型直接当成投票。

**英文原文**

Links from other sites to yours. Their AEO relevance is indirect, since they drive the organic rank that predicts citation, rather than being read as votes by the model.

### 334. 域名权威性（Domain authority）

第三方对域名整体地位的估计。适合用于初步筛选，但不是任何 AI 系统真正使用的指标。

**英文原文**

A third-party estimate of a domain's overall standing. Useful for triage, and not a metric any AI system actually uses.

### 335. 规范 URL（Canonical URL）

在重复页面中，你指定为权威版本的 URL。它决定被引用时哪一个 URL 获得归功，因此在开始报告引用之前，值得先把它设置正确。

**英文原文**

The version of a page you designate as authoritative among duplicates. It determines which URL gets credited when you're cited, which is worth getting right before you start reporting on citations.

### 336. 核心更新（Core update）

Google 排名系统的重大变化。由于自然排名会影响 AI 引用，核心更新如今也会改变 AI 可见度。

**英文原文**

A significant change to Google's ranking systems. Because organic rank feeds AI citation, core updates now move your AI visibility too.

### 337. 网站声誉滥用（Site reputation abuse）

Google 针对在成熟域名上发布无关第三方内容、以利用其地位的政策。它于 2024 年 3 月宣布，同年 11 月收紧，取消了“有第一方监督”这一辩护理由；无论规模大小都适用。

**英文原文**

Google's policy against publishing unrelated third-party content on an established domain to exploit its standing. [Announced in March 2024](<https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies#site-reputation-abuse>) and tightened that November to remove the first-party-oversight defense, it applies regardless of scale.

### 338. 规模化内容滥用（Scaled content abuse）

Google 反对批量生产低价值页面的政策，包括使用 AI 批量生成。这条边界使“直接生成一千页”成为坏计划。

**英文原文**

Google's policy against mass-producing low-value pages, including with AI. It's the guardrail that makes "just generate a thousand pages" a bad plan.

### 339. 关键词堆砌（Keyword stuffing）

不自然地重复词语以示相关。最初的 GEO 研究测试了这一做法，发现其位置调整词数低于基线，因此将其归类为无效方法。它在 AI 搜索中失败的原因，与在传统搜索中失败的原因大体相同。

**英文原文**

Repeating terms unnaturally to signal relevance. The [original GEO research](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09735>) tested it and found it scored below baseline on position-adjusted word count, classifying it as non-performing, so it fails in AI Search for much the same reason it failed in search.


## 15. 风险与失败模式／Risks and failure modes

### 340. 知识衰减（Knowledge decay）

模型重复那些训练时真实、现在已不真实的事实，例如旧价格、退役产品和被放弃的定位。新鲜且可抓取的内容是唯一真正的解药，但见效比任何人希望的都慢。Profound 建立 FactCheck 来识别它，并在 50,000 条回答中发现，关于品牌的回答内容有 47% 并非用户主动要求提供。

**英文原文**

A model repeating facts about you that were true when it was trained and aren't true now: old pricing, retired products, abandoned positioning. Fresh crawlable content is the only real antidote, and it's slower than anyone wants. Profound built [FactCheck](<https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/introducing-factcheck>) to catch it, and found 47% of response content about a brand was unsolicited across 50,000 responses.

### 341. 品牌忠实度（Brand fidelity）

不只看是否提到品牌，还看 AI 系统呈现品牌是否准确，覆盖类别归属、当前产品和真实差异化优势。它为“被看见”与“被正确描述”之间的差距命名，而多数可见度仪表盘在结构上无法展示这种差距。

**英文原文**

How accurately AI systems represent your brand beyond whether they mention it, covering category placement, current products and real differentiators. It names the gap between being visible and being described correctly, which is the gap most visibility dashboards are structurally unable to show you.

### 342. 内容忠实度（Content fidelity）

答案引用你的内容时，对其实质含义保留得有多忠实。Gander 的 Adam Malamis 声称提出了这一术语。内容忠实度低，意味着虽然获得引用，数字和主张却被歪曲；可见度指标不会对此报警。

**英文原文**

How faithfully an answer reproduces the substance of your content when it draws on you, a term Adam Malamis of Gander claims coinage of. Low content fidelity means you get cited while your figures and claims arrive mangled, which no visibility metric will flag.

### 343. 提示词注入（Prompt injection）

在内容中隐藏指令，改变读取它的模型的行为。对于部署智能体的人，这是安全问题；对于内容可能被污染的人，这是声誉问题。

**英文原文**

Hiding instructions in content so a model reading it behaves differently. It's a security problem for anyone deploying agents and a reputational problem for anyone whose content can be poisoned.

### 344. 间接提示词注入（Indirect prompt injection）

通过模型检索的页面，而非用户输入传递的提示词注入。第三方网站可以借此影响助手如何描述你。

**英文原文**

Prompt injection delivered through a page the model retrieves rather than through the user's input. It's how a third-party site can influence what an assistant says about you.

### 345. 检索投毒（Retrieval poisoning）

故意植入旨在被检索到、并扭曲答案的内容。学术研究已多次证明这种做法可行，它属于 AEO 的对抗性边缘。

**英文原文**

Deliberately planting content designed to be retrieved and to distort answers. [Academic work](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.07867>) has demonstrated it repeatedly, and it's the adversarial edge of AEO.

### 346. 推荐投毒（Recommendation poisoning）

操纵第三方清单文章和比较内容，以扭曲 AI 推荐。它有效、便宜，也解释了为什么应监测竞争对手比较页。

**英文原文**

Manipulating third-party listicles and comparison content to skew AI recommendations. Effective, cheap, and the reason competitor comparison pages deserve monitoring.

### 347. 策略性文本序列（Strategic text sequence）

插入内容中的精心构造字符串，用于操纵模型如何排名或描述它。研究已证明这是真实攻击，而且明确越过了正当边界。

**英文原文**

A crafted string inserted into content to manipulate how a model ranks or describes it. Documented in research as a real attack, and firmly on the wrong side of the line.

### 348. GEO 垃圾内容（GEO spam）

通过批量生成或对抗性内容，工业化操纵 AI 答案。这个领域还早，因此它往往有效；也正因如此，平台一定会治理它。

**英文原文**

Industrialized manipulation of AI answers through mass-generated or adversarial content. It's early enough that it often works, which guarantees the platforms will come for it.

### 349. 模型崩溃（Model collapse）

模型在越来越多 AI 生成文本上训练时发生的退化。这是整个生态的长期风险，而不是你按季度管理的事情。

**英文原文**

The degradation that occurs when models are trained on increasing volumes of AI-generated text. A long-term risk to the whole ecosystem rather than something you manage quarterly.

### 350. AI 低质内容（AI slop）（AI slop）

低质量、批量生产的 AI 内容。Merriam-Webster 将“slop”评为 2025 年年度词汇，这在一定程度上反映了公众对当前内容供给的感受。

**英文原文**

Low-quality, mass-produced AI content. [Merriam-Webster made "slop" its word of the year](<https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordplay/word-of-the-year>) for 2025, which is a reasonable indicator of how the public feels about the current supply.

### 351. 幻觉名称抢注（Slopsquatting）（Slopsquatting）

注册模型容易凭空编出的名称、软件包名或域名。这是真实的供应链风险，也是一种奇特的新型拼写抢注。

**英文原文**

Registering names, packages or domains that models tend to hallucinate. A genuine supply-chain risk and a strange new form of typosquatting.

### 352. AI 包装夸大（AI washing）（AI washing）

夸大 AI 在产品或营销项目中发挥的作用。它会引来监管关注，也让所有人更难建立可信的 AI 主张。

**英文原文**

Overstating the role AI plays in a product or a marketing program. It attracts regulatory attention, and it makes credible AI claims harder for everyone.

### 353. 答案泡泡（Answer bubbles）

所有人针对相同问题接收到类似综合答案所产生的视野收窄效应。它奖励既有领先者，使进入新品类比传统搜索时代更难。

**英文原文**

The narrowing effect of everyone receiving similar synthesized answers to the same questions. It rewards incumbents and makes category entry harder than it was in traditional search.

### 354. 既有品牌优势（Incumbent advantage）

AI 答案倾向于强化那些已经得到广泛报道的品牌。这就是挑战者品牌的 AEO 首先是站外问题、其次才是站内问题的结构性原因。

**英文原文**

The tendency of AI answers to reinforce brands that are already well covered. It's the structural reason AEO for a challenger brand is an offsite problem before it's an onsite one.

### 355. 关于品牌的幻觉主张（Hallucinated claims about your brand）

针对定价、功能、客户或领导层，自信而具体地编造的陈述。由于它们并非每次运行都会出现，检测需要抽样监测，这正是 FactCheck 的作用。

**英文原文**

Confident, specific, invented statements about your pricing, features, customers or leadership. Detecting them requires sampled monitoring, because they don't appear in every run, which is what [FactCheck](<https://www.tryprofound.com/features/answer-engine-insights/factcheck>) does.

### 356. 循环引用来源（Circular sourcing）

AI 答案引用的内容，本身又是从 AI 答案衍生而来的。一个自信的错误就这样变成共识；这种现象已出现在本行业自己的统计数据中。

**英文原文**

When AI answers cite content that was itself derived from AI answers. It's how one confident error becomes the consensus, and it's already visible in this industry's own statistics.
